name: Deep-search YouTube for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-youtube-deep-result-20260824

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and descriptions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-youtube-deep
          mkdir -p tmp-se-youtube-deep
          cp -a published/. tmp-se-youtube-deep/
          git add -f tmp-se-youtube-deep
          git commit -m 'Deep-search YouTube for public SE 0.7 saves'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"

name: Deep-search YouTube for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-youtube-deep-result-20260824

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and descriptions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-youtube-deep
          mkdir -p tmp-se-youtube-deep
          cp -a published/. tmp-se-youtube-deep/
          git add -f tmp-se-youtube-deep
          git commit -m 'Deep-search YouTube for public SE 0.7 saves'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"

            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-youtube-deep
          mkdir -p tmp-se-youtube-deep
          cp -a published/. tmp-se-youtube-deep/
          git add -f tmp-se-youtube-deep
          git commit -m 'Deep-search YouTube for public SE 0.7 saves'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"

No worries about the timing. It's all hobbies here. 🎉

And thanks for the save. I can reproduce the issue with it. And now I understand what's going wrong.
The routine works by first planning everything above ground (except for some other special cases) and bury the pipes afterwards.

I am not exactly sure why my earlier tests didn't have this issue, though. Maybe the routine decided to not-bury the pipe in those scenarios for other reasons.
I'll post back when I have a fix. Thanks again for reporting it.

Could you share your save file so I can have a proper look at your specific scenario?\nXcone\n8 months ago\nI've quickly dug through my test cases, and found one that indicates that mechanism still works.\nAnd I also tried the map editor to recreate a similar layout to match your screenshot. I succeeded at creating a similar pipeplan, but there too, it preserved a pipe to connect to.\nSo I won't be able to address this without a save in which this happens.\nAsterixyz\n8 months ago\n(updated 8 months ago)\nheres the save file, its on planet igrys with the water field on the wayyy right side\nhttps://drive.google.com/file/d/1nMip4ceTgxMbiR745H40FauzEmLFWP6R/view?usp=drive_link\nsorry for late reply, was watching a movie.\nAsterixyz\n8 months ago\nI did manually fix the issue myself by moving the pipe, but was able to consistently get it to happen, so just clear out the ghosts and stuff i placed down\nXcone\n8 months ago\nNo worries about the timing. It's all hobbies here. 🎉\nBesides, you're relatively quick. Its not uncommon having to wait a couple of days.\nAnd thanks for the save. I can reproduce the issue with it. And now I understand what's going wrong.\nThe routine works by first planning everything above ground (except for some other special cases) and bury the pipes afterwards.\nThe bury-routine does take into account neighboring pipes to avoid burying at that position. But it doesn't look for pump-outputs. So the routine is there, it's just incomplete.\nAnd it's going to be a bit of a pain in the ass to fix. Because at the stage of burying pipes, I've already discarded a bunch of data that would help. So I'll need to think for a bit on how I want to fix this.\nI am not exactly sure why my earlier tests didn't have this issue, though. Maybe the routine decided to not-bury the pipe in those scenarios for other reasons.\nI'll post back when I have a fix. Thanks again for reporting it.\nXcone\n8 months ago\nOh ,.. turned out not to be too bad after all.\nI've just released v2.1.19 which should fix the issue.\nAsterixyz\n8 months ago\nThanks for the quick fix, love the mod btw.             <div class="discussion-message-body p16">
                <p>No worries about the timing. It's all hobbies here. 🎉<br>
Besides, you're relatively quick. Its not uncommon having to wait a couple of days.</p>
<p>And thanks for the save. I can reproduce the issue with it. And now I understand what's going wrong. </p>
<p>The routine works by first planning everything above ground (except for some other special cases) and bury the pipes afterwards. <br>
The bury-routine does take into account neighboring pipes to avoid burying at that position. But it doesn't look for pump-outputs. So the routine is there, it's just incomplete.</p>
<p>And it's going to be a bit of a pain in the ass to fix. Because at the stage of burying pipes, I've already discarded a bunch of data that would help. So I'll need to think for a bit on how I want to fix this.</p>
<p>I am not exactly sure why my earlier tests didn't have this issue, though. Maybe the routine decided to not-bury the pipe in those scenarios for other reasons.</p>
<p>I'll post back when I have a fix. Thanks again for reporting it.
            </div>

which is also why piercing ammo jumped onto the cursor only for a split second, cause the ghost piercing ammo is different from the actual piercing ammo in your ammo slot i assume.

    "text": "Filter Helper - Factorio Mods\nFactorio.com\n|\nForums\n|\nWiki\n|\nMod Portal\n|\nAPI Docs\nLog in\nHighlighted mods\nRecently updated\nMost downloaded\nTrending\nSearch mods\nFilter Helper\nby\nMudscape\nAdds context aware quick select for filter inserters.\nUtilities\nMod category: Utilities\nProviding the player with new tools or adjusting the game interface, without fundamentally changing gameplay.\n2 months ago\n1.1 - 2.1\n36.1K\nsource code\nDownload\nInformation\nChangelog\nDownloads\nDependencies\n0 / 63\nDiscussion\n74\nMetrics\ni\n[WIP] Pre-filtering of inserters\nSoul-Burn\n☆\n11 months ago\nAs there were several posts requesting something that allows pre-setting filters on inserters, I decided to combine the ideas in a single post.\nI have ideas in mind that could handle this request, and would like to get comments from users before implementing.\nThere will a toggle, whether a toolbar button, a held hotkey, or if robust enough, a mod setting, which will enable \"smart pre-filtering\", which will work as follows:\nAn inserter pointing towards a belt/chest, will set a filter according to the outputs of the source and the items on the belt/chest. For example, an inserter pointing towards an ash belt will be set to ash. Research would be needed to see if we can filter by the drop lane.\nAn inserter pointing towards a belt/chest, where a different inserter from that entity is already filtered, will be filtered by \"what's left\". For example, if another inserter filters ash, and this inserter is pointing towards a non-ash belt, it will be filtered by \"not ash\" or by the specific items.\nAn inserter from an entity with multiple different items, pointing to anything other than a crafting machine, will be filtered to \"whitelist\". This is for entities such as platform hubs, landing pads, big mixed warehouses.\nAn inserter pointing towards space will be filtered to \"whitelist\".\nWhile it could be nice to change filters after the the inserter was placed, according to changing conditions e.g. a belt/assembler is removed, this can cause more chaos and would probably not be good.\nHoochie\n8 months ago\n(updated 8 months ago)\nI'm not entirely sure how the options you described would work in practice.\nMaybe we could work the other way around? If a manipulator directed from a source that contains multiple items, such as a conveyor belt, chest, or workbench, automatically checks the \"use white filter\" box but doesn't set any filter, we'll avoid the situation where the manipulator immediately picks up any item until the user specifies which item it should pick up.\nExample #1: A chest contains 4 items. Currently, the manipulator picks up any item, or an item based on some internal logic (possibly based on its name, I'm not sure). So, in order for the manipulator to be able to pick up the item I need, I need to specify it in the filters, but the manipulator has already picked up some item after placing it.\nExample #2: The feed contains two items, ash and wood. The manipulator will now grab the first item it encounters, and only after I set a filter will it grab the ash.\nHowever, if the manipulator is set to whitelist mode but without a specific filter, the manipulator will not grab the first item it encounters and will wait for the user to specify which item to grab.\nThat is, we will avoid situations where the manipulator, having several items in the source, takes whatever comes to hand, and the user will not have to deal with cleaning the manipulator itself, the tape, and so on from what the manipulator has already managed to throw there.\nYeah, I see in the discussions that there was already a suggestion about the same thing. I also think it would be easier if the installation happened this way, with a hotkey, or by default if there are two or more items in the source.\nNew response\nLog in to reply\nTerms of Service\n|\nPrivacy\n|\nImprint\n|\nPresskit\n|\nContact\n|\nFAQ\n|\nJobs\nCopyright © 2015 - 2026 Wube Software - all rights reserved."

                  report.append({'name': name, 'version': version, 'status': 'downloaded', 'bytes': destination.stat().st_size, 'sha1': digest, 'url': url.split('?')[0]})

                  report.append({'name': name, 'version': version, 'status': 'failed', 'error': repr(exc), 'url': url.split('?')[0]})

          failures = [entry for entry in report if entry['status'] == 'failed']
          if failures: raise SystemExit(f'{len(failures)} exact mod downloads failed')

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')
              length = struct.unpack('<i', header)[0]; data = b''
              while len(data) < length:
                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))
                  if not chunk: raise RuntimeError('RCON connection closed')
                  data += chunk
              request_id, packet_type = struct.unpack_from('<ii', data, 0)
              return request_id, packet_type, data[8:-2].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

          local report = {tick=game.tick, hours=game.tick/216000, players={}, forces={}, surfaces={}, recipes={}, rocket_science_machines=0, rocket_science_working=0, rocket_science_support={}}
          local real_forces = {}
          for _, force in pairs(game.forces) do if force.name ~= "enemy" and force.name ~= "neutral" then real_forces[force.name] = true end end
          for _, force in pairs(game.forces) do

            if ok2 then row.rocket_science_input = value2 end
            for name, tech in pairs(force.technologies) do
              if tech.researched and (string.find(name, "rocket", 1, true) or string.find(name, "space", 1, true)) then table.insert(row.researched, name) end
            end
            table.sort(row.researched); table.insert(report.forces, row)
          end
          for _, player in pairs(game.players) do table.insert(report.players, {name=player.name, force=player.force.name, surface=player.surface and player.surface.name or nil, position=player.position}) end
          for _, surface in pairs(game.surfaces) do
            local row = {name=surface.name, index=surface.index, chunks=0, player_entities=0, entities={}, rocket_science_machines=0}
            for _ in surface.get_chunks() do row.chunks = row.chunks + 1 end
            for force_name, _ in pairs(real_forces) do
              local ok, count = pcall(function() return surface.count_entities_filtered{force=force_name} end)
              if ok then row.player_entities = row.player_entities + count end
            end
            for _, entity_name in pairs({"se-rocket-launch-pad", "se-rocket-landing-pad", "se-space-science-lab", "se-space-assembling-machine", "se-space-manufactory", "rocket-silo"}) do
              local ok, count = pcall(function() return surface.count_entities_filtered{name=entity_name} end)
              row.entities[entity_name] = ok and count or -1
            end
            for _, entity in pairs(surface.find_entities_filtered{type={"assembling-machine", "furnace", "rocket-silo"}}) do
              local ok, recipe = pcall(function() return entity.get_recipe() end)
              if ok and recipe then
                report.recipes[recipe.name] = (report.recipes[recipe.name] or 0) + 1
                if recipe.name == "se-rocket-science-pack" then
                  report.rocket_science_machines = report.rocket_science_machines + 1
                  row.rocket_science_machines = row.rocket_science_machines + 1
                  local status_ok, status = pcall(function() return entity.status end)
                  if status_ok and status == defines.entity_status.working then report.rocket_science_working = report.rocket_science_working + 1 end
                end
                if string.find(recipe.name, "rocket", 1, true) or string.find(recipe.name, "satellite", 1, true) then report.rocket_science_support[recipe.name] = (report.rocket_science_support[recipe.name] or 0) + 1 end
              end
            end

          from pathlib import Path

          token = os.environ['GH_TOKEN']

          def api(url: str):
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=api_headers)
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as r:
                  return json.load(r)

          queries = [
              'factorio save pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio saves pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio-save pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio_saves pushed:>=2025-09-22',

                  url = 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({
                      'q': q, 'per_page': 100, 'page': page, 'sort': 'updated', 'order': 'desc'
                  })
                  try:
                      data = api(url)
                  except Exception as exc:
                      search_errors.append({'query': q, 'page': page, 'error': repr(exc)})

                  for item in items:

                          'size_kb': item.get('size', 0),
                          'description': item.get('description'),
                          'pushed_at': item.get('pushed_at'),
                          'html_url': item.get('html_url'),
                      }
                  if len(items) < 100:

          for full in [
              'NotAFreak/.factorio', 'Sebastian-Schuchmann/factorio-saves',

          ]:
              if full not in repos:
                  try:
                      item = api('https://api.github.com/repos/' + full)
                      repos[full] = {

                          'size_kb': item.get('size', 0),
                          'description': item.get('description'),

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self, data: bytes): self.data, self.offset = data, 0
              def u8(self):
                  v = self.data[self.offset]; self.offset += 1; return v
              def u16(self):
                  v = struct.unpack_from('<H', self.data, self.offset)[0]; self.offset += 2; return v
              def u32(self):
                  v = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.data, self.offset)[0]; self.offset += 4; return v
              def version(self): return (self.u16(), self.u16(), self.u16(), self.u16())
              def opt(self, bits, fv):
                  if fv > (0, 14, 14, 0):
                      first = self.u8()
                      if first != 0xff: return first
                  return self.u16() if bits == 16 else self.u32()
              def string(self, fv):

                  return raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace')

                  if size < 100_000 or size > 180_000_000: continue
                  score = 0
                  low = (full + '/' + path + ' ' + (repo.get('description') or '')).lower()
                  for word, points in [
                      ('space-exploration', 40), ('space exploration', 40), ('se0.7', 35), ('se07', 35),
                      ('rocket', 20), ('space', 12), ('save', 8), ('autosave', 7), ('factorio', 3),
                  ]:
                      if word in low: score += points
                  # Medium-sized saves are more plausible around the requested checkpoint.
                  mb = size / 1_000_000
                  if 15 <= mb <= 100: score += 8

                              'rocket_science': b'se-rocket-science-pack',
                              'launch_pad': b'se-rocket-launch-pad',
                              'cargo_section': b'se-cargo-rocket-section',
                              'nauvis_orbit': b'Nauvis Orbit',
                              'space_lab': b'se-space-science-lab',
                              'space_scaffold': b'se-space-platform-scaffold',
                          }.items(): marker_counts[label] = script.count(marker)
                      rec = {
                          **item, 'raw_url': raw_url, 'downloaded_bytes': len(data),
                          'factorio_save': True, 'header': header, 'marker_counts': marker_counts,
                          'se_version': mods.get('space-exploration'),
                          'k2_version': mods.get('Krastorio2'),
                      }

                              rec['published_preview'] = 'previews/' + safe + '.jpg'
              except Exception as exc:

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')
              length = struct.unpack('<i', header)[0]; data = b''
              while len(data) < length:
                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))
                  if not chunk: raise RuntimeError('RCON connection closed')
                  data += chunk
              request_id, packet_type = struct.unpack_from('<ii', data, 0)
              return request_id, packet_type, data[8:-2].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

          def run(args, timeout=180):
              return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)

          for q in queries:
              result = run(["yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-json", f"ytsearch40:{q}"], timeout=240)
              pathlib.Path("published/search-stderr.txt").open("a").write(result.stderr)
              for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
                  try:
                      obj = json.loads(line)
                  except Exception:
                      continue
                  vid = obj.get("id")
                  if not vid:
                      continue
                  title = obj.get("title") or ""
                  candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": title, "queries": []})["queries"].append(q)

              candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": "", "queries": ["exact known lead"]})

          # Prioritize titles that are plausibly around the target checkpoint.

              "rocket", "space", "orbit", "science", "cargo", "launch", "preparation",
              "first space", "nauvis", "automation", "automating"

              candidates.values(),
              key=lambda x: (0 if any(w in x["title"].lower() for w in target_words) else 1, x["title"].lower())
          )[:120]

name: Temporary SE Speedrun.com save search

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: "tmp-se-speedrun-result-20260824"

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'

    timeout-minutes: 35

      - name: Search Speedrun.com API and linked run evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published/downloads

          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, time, urllib.error, urllib.parse, urllib.request

          OUT = pathlib.Path('published')
          UA = {'User-Agent': 'JJ-SE-save-search/1.0 (public speedrun data research)'}
          errors = []

          def get_json(url: str, attempts: int = 6):
              for attempt in range(attempts):
                  try:
                      req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as response:
                          return json.load(response)
                  except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                      if exc.code in (420, 429, 502, 503, 504) and attempt + 1 < attempts:
                          time.sleep(3 * (attempt + 1)); continue
                      raise
                  except Exception:
                      if attempt + 1 < attempts:
                          time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1)); continue
                      raise

          API = 'https://www.speedrun.com/api/v1'
          game_queries = ['Factorio', 'Factorio Category Extensions', 'Space Exploration']
          games = {}
          for name in game_queries:
              url = API + '/games?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'name': name, 'max': 200})
              try:
                  for game in get_json(url).get('data', []):
                      international = (game.get('names') or {}).get('international', '')
                      if 'factorio' in international.lower() or international.lower() == 'space exploration':
                          games[game['id']] = game
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'game-search', 'name': name, 'error': repr(exc)})

          # Pull derived/category-extension games from every Factorio match.
          for game in list(games.values()):
              try:
                  data = get_json(API + f"/games/{game['id']}/derived-games").get('data', [])
                  for derived in data:
                      games[derived['id']] = derived
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'derived-games', 'game': game['id'], 'error': repr(exc)})

          categories = {}
          variables = {}
          matching_category_ids = set()
          matching_value_filters = []
          text_hits = []

          def contains_se(text: str) -> bool:
              low = (text or '').lower()
              return ('space exploration' in low or 'space-exploration' in low or
                      re.search(r'(^|[^a-z0-9])se\s*0?[67]([^a-z0-9]|$)', low) is not None)

          for game in games.values():
              gid = game['id']
              try:
                  cats = get_json(API + f'/games/{gid}/categories?max=200').get('data', [])
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'categories', 'game': gid, 'error': repr(exc)})
                  continue
              for cat in cats:
                  cat['_game'] = gid
                  categories[cat['id']] = cat
                  combined = ' '.join([cat.get('name') or '', cat.get('rules') or '', cat.get('weblink') or ''])
                  if contains_se(combined):
                      matching_category_ids.add(cat['id'])
                      text_hits.append({'type': 'category', 'game': gid, 'category': cat})
              try:
                  vars_ = get_json(API + f'/games/{gid}/variables?max=200').get('data', [])
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'variables', 'game': gid, 'error': repr(exc)})
                  vars_ = []
              for var in vars_:
                  var['_game'] = gid
                  variables[var['id']] = var
                  if contains_se((var.get('name') or '') + ' ' + (var.get('description') or '')):
                      text_hits.append({'type': 'variable', 'game': gid, 'variable': var})
                  values = ((var.get('values') or {}).get('values') or {})
                  for value_id, value in values.items():
                      label = value.get('label') or ''
                      rules = value.get('rules') or ''
                      if contains_se(label + ' ' + rules):
                          matching_value_filters.append({'game': gid, 'variable': var['id'], 'value': value_id, 'label': label, 'rules': rules, 'category': var.get('category')})
                          text_hits.append({'type': 'value', 'game': gid, 'variable_id': var['id'], 'value_id': value_id, 'label': label, 'rules': rules})
                          if var.get('category'):
                              matching_category_ids.add(var['category'])

          # Fetch every run for Factorio-family games. There are only a few thousand.
          all_runs = []
          for game in games.values():
              gid = game['id']
              offset = 0
              while True:
                  url = API + '/runs?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'game': gid, 'max': 200, 'offset': offset, 'orderby': 'submitted', 'direction': 'desc'})
                  try:
                      page = get_json(url).get('data', [])
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage': 'runs', 'game': gid, 'offset': offset, 'error': repr(exc)})
                      break
                  all_runs.extend(page)
                  if len(page) < 200: break
                  offset += len(page)
                  time.sleep(0.7)

          url_re = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"\']+')
          file_re = re.compile(r'(?:\.zip(?:[?&#]|$)|\.7z(?:[?&#]|$)|\.rar(?:[?&#]|$)|\.sav(?:[?&#]|$)|drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|github\.com/.*/(?:releases|raw|blob)|archive\.org)', re.I)
          evidence_words = re.compile(r'\b(save|savegame|save file|replay|factorio zip|map download)\b', re.I)

          candidates = []
          for run in all_runs:
              cat_id = run.get('category')
              values = run.get('values') or {}
              exact_se_value = any(values.get(f['variable']) == f['value'] for f in matching_value_filters)
              comment = run.get('comment') or ''
              videos = ((run.get('videos') or {}).get('links') or [])
              video_uris = [v.get('uri') for v in videos if v.get('uri')]
              urls = [u.rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(comment)]
              linked_files = [u for u in urls if file_re.search(u)]
              likely_se = cat_id in matching_category_ids or exact_se_value or contains_se(comment)
              evidence = bool(linked_files or evidence_words.search(comment))
              if likely_se or evidence:
                  candidates.append({
                      'id': run.get('id'), 'weblink': run.get('weblink'), 'game': run.get('game'),
                      'category': cat_id, 'date': run.get('date'), 'submitted': run.get('submitted'),
                      'status': run.get('status'), 'times': run.get('times'), 'players': run.get('players'),
                      'values': values, 'comment': comment, 'video_uris': video_uris,
                      'urls': urls, 'linked_files': linked_files, 'likely_space_exploration': likely_se,
                      'matched_category': cat_id in matching_category_ids, 'matched_value': exact_se_value,
                  })

          # Try to fetch HTML run pages for likely SE runs because file links may be rendered outside API comments.
          for rec in candidates:
              if not rec['likely_space_exploration'] or not rec.get('weblink'): continue
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(rec['weblink'], headers=UA)
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40) as response:
                      html = response.read(4_000_000).decode('utf-8', 'replace')
                  html_urls = [u.replace('\\u0026', '&').replace('&amp;', '&').rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(html)]
                  rec['html_file_links'] = [u for u in html_urls if file_re.search(u)]
              except Exception as exc:
                  rec['html_error'] = repr(exc)

          # Attempt actual downloads of public file-host links where a direct URL is already exposed.
          downloads = []
          dedup_links = []
          seen = set()
          for rec in candidates:
              if not rec['likely_space_exploration']: continue
              for u in rec.get('linked_files', []) + rec.get('html_file_links', []):
                  if u not in seen:
                      seen.add(u); dedup_links.append((rec, u))
          for index, (rec, u) in enumerate(dedup_links[:50]):
              direct = u
              if 'drive.google.com/file/d/' in u:
                  m = re.search(r'/file/d/([^/]+)', u)
                  if m: direct = 'https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=' + m.group(1) + '&export=download&confirm=t'
              elif 'dropbox.com/' in u:
                  direct = re.sub(r'[?&]dl=0', '', u)
                  direct += ('&' if '?' in direct else '?') + 'dl=1'
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(direct, headers=UA)
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as response:
                      data = response.read(200_000_001)
                      ctype = response.headers.get('Content-Type')
                  if len(data) > 200_000_000: raise RuntimeError('file over 200 MB limit')
                  name = f"{index:02d}_{rec['id']}.bin"
                  pathlib.Path('published/downloads', name).write_bytes(data)
                  downloads.append({'run': rec['id'], 'source': u, 'direct': direct, 'bytes': len(data), 'content_type': ctype, 'file': 'downloads/' + name, 'magic': data[:32].hex()})
              except Exception as exc:
                  downloads.append({'run': rec['id'], 'source': u, 'direct': direct, 'error': repr(exc)})

          summary = {
              'games': len(games), 'categories': len(categories), 'variables': len(variables),
              'matching_categories': len(matching_category_ids), 'matching_values': len(matching_value_filters),
              'all_runs': len(all_runs), 'candidate_runs': len(candidates),
              'likely_se_runs': sum(1 for r in candidates if r['likely_space_exploration']),
              'public_file_links': len(dedup_links), 'downloads_attempted': len(downloads),
          }
          OUT.joinpath('games.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(games.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('categories.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(categories.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('variables.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(variables.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('matching-text.json').write_text(json.dumps(text_hits, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('candidate-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(candidates, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('downloads.json').write_text(json.dumps(downloads, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('summary.txt').write_text('\n'.join(f'{k}: {v}' for k,v in summary.items()))
          print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
          PY

          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

        if: always()

name: Temporary SE public video API search

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: "tmp-se-video-api-result-20260824"

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Search public video metadata APIs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          import json, re, time, urllib.parse, urllib.request, urllib.error, pathlib, ssl

          ssl._create_default_https_context = ssl._create_unverified_context
          ua = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 SE-save-search/1.0'}
          def get_json(url, timeout=25, data=None, headers=None):
              h = dict(ua)
              if headers: h.update(headers)
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=h)
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                  return json.load(r)

          url_re = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"\']+')
          host_re = re.compile(r'(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|github\.com|gitlab\.com|patreon\.com|ko-fi\.com|refactorio\.de|\.zip(?:[?&#]|$))', re.I)
          queries = [
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science',
              'Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 save game',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
          ]
          exact_ids = {'dDyBD4oE5Qg'}
          errors=[]; instances=[]; videos={}; inspected=[]; links=[]

          # Discover Invidious instances with API enabled.
          try:
              raw = get_json('https://api.invidious.io/instances.json', timeout=30)
              for host, meta in raw:
                  details = meta.get('details') or {}
                  if meta.get('type') == 'https' and details.get('api') and details.get('monitor', {}).get('dailyRatios'):
                      instances.append('https://' + host)
                  elif meta.get('type') == 'https' and details.get('api'):
                      instances.append('https://' + host)
          except Exception as exc:
              errors.append({'stage':'instances','error':repr(exc)})

          # Add known public instances, availability varies by the minute because naturally it does.
          instances += [
              'https://inv.nadeko.net','https://yewtu.be','https://invidious.nerdvpn.de',
              'https://inv.us.projectsegfau.lt','https://invidious.private.coffee',
              'https://invidious.privacyredirect.com','https://iv.ggtyler.dev'
          ]
          seen=set(); instances=[x for x in instances if not (x in seen or seen.add(x))]

          working=[]
          for base in instances[:50]:
              try:
                  data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/stats', timeout=12)
                  if isinstance(data, dict): working.append(base)
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage':'probe','base':base,'error':repr(exc)})
              if len(working) >= 8: break

          for q in queries:
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/search?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'q':q,'type':'video','sort_by':'relevance'}), timeout=20)
                      for item in data[:30]:
                          vid=item.get('videoId')
                          if vid:
                              videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':item.get('title'),'author':item.get('author'),'queries':[]})['queries'].append(q)
                      break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'search','base':base,'query':q,'error':repr(exc)})
          for vid in exact_ids: videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':'','author':'','queries':['exact lead']})

          target_words=('rocket','space','orbit','science','cargo','launch','automation','automating','nauvis')
          ordered=sorted(videos.values(), key=lambda x:(0 if any(w in (x.get('title') or '').lower() for w in target_words) else 1,(x.get('title') or '').lower()))[:180]

          # YouTube Innertube fallback. The WEB client often returns shortDescription without login.
          def youtube_innertube(vid):
              body=json.dumps({'context':{'client':{'clientName':'WEB','clientVersion':'2.20260820.00.00','hl':'en'}},'videoId':vid}).encode()
              return get_json('https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false', timeout=25, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Origin':'https://www.youtube.com'})

          for idx,item in enumerate(ordered):
              vid=item['videoId']; meta=None; source=None
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      meta=get_json(base + '/api/v1/videos/' + vid, timeout=20); source=base; break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'video','base':base,'id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              if meta is None:
                  try:
                      raw=youtube_innertube(vid)
                      vd=raw.get('videoDetails') or {}
                      if vd:
                          meta={'videoId':vid,'title':vd.get('title'),'author':vd.get('author'),'description':vd.get('shortDescription'),'lengthSeconds':vd.get('lengthSeconds')}
                          source='youtube-innertube'
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'innertube','id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              rec=dict(item); rec['source']=source
              if meta:
                  desc=meta.get('description') or meta.get('shortDescription') or ''
                  rec.update({'title':meta.get('title') or rec.get('title'),'author':meta.get('author') or meta.get('authorId') or rec.get('author'),'description':desc,'published':meta.get('publishedText') or meta.get('published'),'lengthSeconds':meta.get('lengthSeconds')})
                  urls=[u.rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(desc)]
                  rec['urls']=urls; rec['potential_save_links']=[u for u in urls if host_re.search(u)]
                  for u in rec['potential_save_links']:
                      links.append({'videoId':vid,'title':rec.get('title'),'author':rec.get('author'),'url':'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='+vid,'link':u})
              inspected.append(rec)
              if idx%25==24: time.sleep(1)

          pathlib.Path('published/working-instances.json').write_text(json.dumps(working,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(inspected,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(links,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(f"{x['title']} | {x['author']}\n{x['url']}\n{x['link']}" for x in links))
          pathlib.Path('published/exact-bold-viking.json').write_text(json.dumps([x for x in inspected if x['videoId']=='dDyBD4oE5Qg'],indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2))
          summary={'instances_discovered':len(instances),'instances_working':len(working),'videos_found':len(videos),'videos_inspected':len(inspected),'save_links':len(links)}
          pathlib.Path('published/summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish findings
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

BRANCH: tmp-se-consolidate-history-20260824
PATH: .github/workflows/tmp-se-consolidate-history.yml
SIZE: 11182 | TARGET_HITS: 16 | STAGE_HITS: 4
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: Consolidate all previous SE search branches

on:
  push:
    branches: [tmp-se-consolidate-history-20260824]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  consolidate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Fetch and index all temporary SE branches
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf se-history-consolidated
          mkdir -p se-history-consolidated
          git fetch --no-tags origin '+refs/heads/tmp-se-*:refs/remotes/origin/tmp-se-*'
          cat > /tmp/consolidate.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations

          import csv
          import json
          import pathlib
          import re
          import subprocess
          from collections import Counter, defaultdict

          OUT = pathlib.Path('se-history-consolidated')
          OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

          def git(*args: str, check: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
              return subprocess.run(['git', *args], text=True, capture_output=True, check=check)

          refs = git('for-each-ref', '--format=%(refname:short)', 'refs/remotes/origin/tmp-se-*').stdout.splitlines()
          refs = sorted(r for r in refs if r and not r.endswith('/HEAD'))

          TEXT_EXTS = {'.txt', '.json', '.md', '.csv', '.tsv', '.log', '.html', '.htm', '.yml', '.yaml', '.lua', '.py', '.sh'}
          MAX_TEXT = 3_000_000
          PATH_PRIORITY = re.compile(r'(?i)(summary|status|result|record|candidate|manifest|verdict|report|console|error|header|progress|listing|match|url)')
          TARGET = re.compile(
              r'(?i)(rocket[ -]?science|cargo[ -]?rocket|launch[ -]?pad|nauvis[ -]?orbit|'
              r'satellite|space[ -]?exploration|\bSE\s*0\.7|0\.7\.\d+|'
              r'exact[ -]?match|launch[ -]?ready|unvisited|untouched[ -]?orbit|'
              r'Ohoots|lazy_kojocho|boobers-SE|sandbox_not_opening|Asterixyz|'
              r'drive\.google\.com|user-attachments/files|\.zip\b|save[ -]?(?:file|game)|download)'
          )
          STAGE = re.compile(r'(?i)(rocket[ -]?science|cargo[ -]?rocket|launch[ -]?pad|nauvis[ -]?orbit|satellite|launch[ -]?ready|unvisited|untouched[ -]?orbit)')
          URL_RX = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\'\\]+', re.I)
          DRIVE_RX = re.compile(r'(?:drive\.google\.com/(?:file/d/|open\?id=)|drive\.usercontent\.google\.com/download\?id=)([-\w]{15,})', re.I)

          all_entries: list[dict] = []
          text_records: list[dict] = []
          urls: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
          drive_ids: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
          branch_stats = Counter()
          full_sections: list[str] = []
          match_rows: list[dict] = []
          errors: list[dict] = []

          for ref in refs:
              branch = ref.removeprefix('origin/')
              proc = git('ls-tree', '-r', '-l', ref, check=False)
              if proc.returncode:
                  errors.append({'branch': branch, 'error': proc.stderr})
                  continue
              entries = []
              for raw in proc.stdout.splitlines():
                  # Format: MODE TYPE SHA SIZE<TAB>PATH. Symlinks/submodules can use '-'.
                  try:
                      left, path = raw.split('\t', 1)
                      mode, typ, sha, size_text = left.split(None, 3)
                      size = int(size_text) if size_text.isdigit() else None
                  except Exception:
                      continue
                  entry = {'branch': branch, 'path': path, 'sha': sha, 'size': size, 'type': typ, 'mode': mode}
                  entries.append(entry)
                  all_entries.append(entry)
              branch_stats[(branch, 'files')] = len(entries)
              branch_stats[(branch, 'bytes')] = sum(e['size'] or 0 for e in entries)

              for entry in entries:
                  path = entry['path']
                  size = entry['size']
                  suffix = pathlib.PurePosixPath(path).suffix.lower()
                  if suffix in {'.zip', '.sav', '.7z', '.rar'}:
                      match_rows.append({
                          'branch': branch, 'path': path, 'line': 0,
                          'kind': 'ARCHIVE_ENTRY', 'text': f"repository archive entry size={size}",
                      })
                  if suffix not in TEXT_EXTS or size is None or size > MAX_TEXT:
                      continue
                  shown = git('show', f'{ref}:{path}', check=False)
                  if shown.returncode:
                      errors.append({'branch': branch, 'path': path, 'error': shown.stderr[-1000:]})
                      continue
                  content = shown.stdout
                  target_hits = len(TARGET.findall(content))
                  stage_hits = len(STAGE.findall(content))
                  priority = bool(PATH_PRIORITY.search(path))
                  text_records.append({
                      'branch': branch, 'path': path, 'size': size,
                      'target_hits': target_hits, 'stage_hits': stage_hits,
                      'priority_path': priority,
                  })

                  for line_no, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), 1):
                      if TARGET.search(line):
                          match_rows.append({
                              'branch': branch, 'path': path, 'line': line_no,
                              'kind': 'MATCH', 'text': line[:4000],
                          })
                      for raw_url in URL_RX.findall(line):
                          url = raw_url.rstrip('.,;:!?)\]}>")\'')
                          if url:
                              urls[url].append({'branch': branch, 'path': path, 'line': line_no, 'text': line[:1500]})
                      for m in DRIVE_RX.finditer(line):
                          drive_ids[m.group(1)].append({'branch': branch, 'path': path, 'line': line_no, 'text': line[:1500]})

                  # Preserve complete likely result files. Skip ordinary source files unless they
                  # contain actual stage evidence or URLs, otherwise the report becomes a YAML landfill.
                  keep_full = (
                      (priority and not path.startswith('.github/')) or
                      (stage_hits >= 2 and target_hits >= 4 and size <= 300_000) or
                      (drive_ids and 'drive.google.com' in content and size <= 300_000)
                  )
                  if keep_full and content.strip():
                      full_sections.extend([
                          '\n' + '=' * 120,
                          f'BRANCH: {branch}',
                          f'PATH: {path}',
                          f'SIZE: {size} | TARGET_HITS: {target_hits} | STAGE_HITS: {stage_hits}',
                          '-' * 120,
                          content[:300_000],
                      ])

          # De-duplicate repeated branch copies of the same source line, but preserve result provenance.
          unique_matches = []
          seen_match = set()
          for row in match_rows:
              key = (row['branch'], row['path'], row['line'], row['text'])
              if key not in seen_match:
                  seen_match.add(key)
                  unique_matches.append(row)

          with (OUT / 'branch-files.tsv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['branch', 'path', 'size', 'type', 'mode', 'sha'], delimiter='\t')
              w.writeheader(); w.writerows(all_entries)
          with (OUT / 'text-index.tsv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['branch', 'path', 'size', 'target_hits', 'stage_hits', 'priority_path'], delimiter='\t')
              w.writeheader(); w.writerows(sorted(text_records, key=lambda r: (-r['stage_hits'], -r['target_hits'], r['branch'], r['path'])))
          with (OUT / 'keyword-matches.tsv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['branch', 'path', 'line', 'kind', 'text'], delimiter='\t')
              w.writeheader(); w.writerows(unique_matches)
          (OUT / 'urls.json').write_text(json.dumps(urls, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
          (OUT / 'drive-ids.json').write_text(json.dumps(drive_ids, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
          (OUT / 'full-relevant-files.txt').write_text('\n'.join(full_sections), encoding='utf-8')
          (OUT / 'errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')

          archive_entries = [e for e in all_entries if pathlib.PurePosixPath(e['path']).suffix.lower() in {'.zip', '.sav', '.7z', '.rar'}]
          ranked = sorted(text_records, key=lambda r: (-r['stage_hits'], -r['target_hits'], r['branch'], r['path']))
          summary = [
              f'Branches indexed: {len(refs)}',
              f'Files indexed: {len(all_entries)}',
              f'Text files read: {len(text_records)}',
              f'Unique URLs: {len(urls)}',
              f'Unique Google Drive IDs: {len(drive_ids)}',
              f'Archive entries committed in result branches: {len(archive_entries)}',
              f'Errors: {len(errors)}',
              '',
              'ARCHIVE ENTRIES',
              '=' * 100,
          ]
          for e in archive_entries:
              summary.append(f"{e['branch']}\t{e['size']}\t{e['path']}")
          summary.extend(['', 'GOOGLE DRIVE IDS', '=' * 100])
          for drive_id, contexts in sorted(drive_ids.items(), key=lambda kv: (-len(kv[1]), kv[0])):
              summary.append(f'{drive_id}\toccurrences={len(contexts)}')
              for c in contexts[:5]:
                  summary.append(f"  {c['branch']}:{c['path']}:{c['line']}  {c['text'][:500]}")
          summary.extend(['', 'TOP STAGE-RELEVANT TEXT FILES', '=' * 100])
          for r in ranked[:250]:
              if r['stage_hits'] or r['target_hits'] >= 3:
                  summary.append(
                      f"stage={r['stage_hits']} target={r['target_hits']} size={r['size']}\t{r['branch']}:{r['path']}"
                  )
          (OUT / 'SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(summary), encoding='utf-8')
          print('\n'.join(summary[:800]))
          PY
          python3 /tmp/consolidate.py | tee se-history-consolidated/console.txt

      - name: Publish consolidated history
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B tmp-se-consolidate-history-result-20260824
          rm -rf tmp-se-consolidated-history
          mkdir -p tmp-se-consolidated-history
          cp -a se-history-consolidated/. tmp-se-consolidated-history/ || true
          git add -f tmp-se-consolidated-history
          git commit -m 'Publish consolidated SE search history' || true
          git push --force origin HEAD:refs/heads/tmp-se-consolidate-history-result-20260824

name: Deep-search YouTube for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-youtube-deep-result-20260824

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and descriptions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-youtube-deep
          mkdir -p tmp-se-youtube-deep
          cp -a published/. tmp-se-youtube-deep/
          git add -f tmp-se-youtube-deep
          git commit -m 'Deep-search YouTube for public SE 0.7 saves'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"

BRANCH: tmp-se-current-headers-20260824
PATH: .github/workflows/tmp-se-current-headers.yml
SIZE: 9291 | TARGET_HITS: 14 | STAGE_HITS: 4
