name: Temporary SE candidate header inspection

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-candidate-header-result-20260824

jobs:
  inspect:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Download and inspect
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published/previews published/listings
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade gdown
          cat > work/inspect.py <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, pathlib, struct, subprocess, zipfile
          P=pathlib.Path
          candidates=[
            ('1Tin_CrL075mHPVhDVdZtFErzZb86Hxbo','miniloader_migration_06146','SE 0.6.146 migration save'),
            ('1nScbABVE1hugI9Oj5Li6XRotivrJuBsp','migration_workaround_0754','migrated to SE 0.7.54'),
            ('1vjkxLhfwbmAmB_EA3MEdLSJ5PfK1JYzT','factorissimo_k2se','K2SE Factorissimo save'),
          ]
          class R:
            def __init__(self,d):self.d=d;self.o=0
            def u8(self):v=self.d[self.o];self.o+=1;return v
            def u16(self):v=struct.unpack_from('<H',self.d,self.o)[0];self.o+=2;return v
            def u32(self):v=struct.unpack_from('<I',self.d,self.o)[0];self.o+=4;return v
            def ver(self):return self.u16(),self.u16(),self.u16(),self.u16()
            def opt(self,b,fv):
              if fv>(0,14,14,0):
                x=self.u8()
                if x!=255:return x
              return self.u16() if b==16 else self.u32()
            def text(self,fv):
              n=self.opt(32,fv);v=self.d[self.o:self.o+n];self.o+=n;return v.decode('utf-8','replace')
            def v48(self,fv):return self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv)
          def header(d):
            r=R(d);fv=r.ver();r.u8();x={'factorio_version':'.'.join(map(str,fv[:3])),'factorio_version_full':'.'.join(map(str,fv)),'save_name':r.text(fv),'campaign':r.text(fv),'base_mod':r.text(fv)}
            x['difficulty']=r.u8();x['finished']=bool(r.u8());x['player_won']=bool(r.u8());x['next_level']=r.text(fv);x['can_continue']=bool(r.u8());x['finished_but_continuing']=bool(r.u8());x['saving_replay']=bool(r.u8());x['allow_non_admin_debug']=bool(r.u8());x['loaded_from']='.'.join(map(str,r.v48(fv)));x['loaded_from_build']=r.u32() if fv[0]>=2 else r.u16();x['allowed_commands']=bool(r.u8())
            if fv[0]>=2:r.o+=4
            mods={}
            for _ in range(r.opt(32,fv)):
              name=r.text(fv);ver='.'.join(map(str,r.v48(fv)));r.u32();mods[name]=ver
            x['mods']=mods;return x
          results=[]
          for fileid,name,note in candidates:
            path=P('work')/(name+'.zip');rec={'id':fileid,'name':name,'note':note}
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['gdown','--no-cookies','-O',str(path),fileid],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=1200)
              rec['download_stderr']=p.stderr[-2000:]
              if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError('gdown exit '+str(p.returncode))
              rec['bytes']=path.stat().st_size
              h=hashlib.sha256()
              with path.open('rb') as f:
                for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(chunk)
              rec['sha256']=h.hexdigest()
              with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
                names=z.namelist();P('published/listings',name+'.txt').write_text('\n'.join(names))
                init=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level-init.dat') or n=='level-init.dat'),None)
                level=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level.dat') or n=='level.dat' or n.endswith('/level.dat0') or n=='level.dat0'),None)
                if not init or not level:raise RuntimeError('not Factorio save')
                hd=header(z.read(init));rec['header']=hd;rec['se_version']=hd['mods'].get('space-exploration');rec['k2_version']=hd['mods'].get('Krastorio2');rec['mod_count']=len(hd['mods'])
                script=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/script.dat') or n=='script.dat'),None)
                if script:
                  b=z.read(script);rec['markers']={k:b.count(v) for k,v in {'rocket_science':b'se-rocket-science-pack','launch_pad':b'se-rocket-launch-pad','cargo_section':b'se-cargo-rocket-section','nauvis_orbit':b'Nauvis Orbit','space_lab':b'se-space-science-lab','space_scaffold':b'se-space-platform-scaffold'}.items()}
                preview=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/preview.jpg') or n=='preview.jpg'),None)
                if preview:(P('published/previews')/(name+'.jpg')).write_bytes(z.read(preview))
            except Exception as e:rec['error']=repr(e)
            results.append(rec)
          P('published/results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
          P('published/summary.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(f"{r['name']}: {r.get('bytes')} bytes, Factorio {r.get('header',{}).get('factorio_version')}, SE {r.get('se_version')}, K2 {r.get('k2_version')}, mods {r.get('mod_count')}, error {r.get('error')}\nmarkers {r.get('markers')}" for r in results))
          print(P('published/summary.txt').read_text())
          PY
          python3 work/inspect.py | tee published/console.txt
      - name: Publish results
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-candidate-header
          mkdir tmp-se-candidate-header
          cp -a published/. tmp-se-candidate-header/
          git add -f tmp-se-candidate-header
          git commit -m 'Parse accessible SE candidate headers'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"

name: Temporary public SE Drive candidate inspection

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: "tmp-se-drive-result-20260824"

jobs:
  inspect:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Download and recursively inspect public candidate bundles
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work/downloads work/actual-saves published/previews published/reports published/chunks published/listings
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade gdown

          cat > work/candidates.json <<'JSON'
          [
            {"id":"1zA_uoOIYn3dpO92empFJY0WPg7XSY29k","name":"rampant_starter_planet_only","source":"veden/Rampant issue 66","note":"SE+K2; author says only starter planet and some satellites, no other planets visited"},
            {"id":"1hyn5Do8q8xDSUK4Aqe6B8uRGE6gGfcJG","name":"blueprint_sandbox_cargo_rocket","source":"EarendelDevelopers/factorio-mods issue 275","note":"SE 0.6.98; cargo rocket launch bug"},
            {"id":"1Tin_CrL075mHPVhDVdZtFErzZb86Hxbo","name":"miniloader_migration_06146","source":"hgschmie/factorio-miniloader-redux issue 31","note":"Known SE 0.6.146 migration bundle"},
            {"id":"1nScbABVE1hugI9Oj5Li6XRotivrJuBsp","name":"migration_workaround_0754","source":"EarendelDevelopers/factorio-mods issue 392","note":"Migrated 0.6 to 0.7 bundle"},
            {"id":"1XlXGfwqmjviKuahV4Ow6K2cCVBlCGQAg","name":"chunky_core_mining_base","source":"EarendelDevelopers/factorio-mods issue 319","note":"SE 0.6.113 chunky base"},
            {"id":"1vjkxLhfwbmAmB_EA3MEdLSJ5PfK1JYzT","name":"factorissimo_k2se","source":"notnotmelon/factorissimo issue 268","note":"K2SE bundle; probably advanced"},
            {"id":"1jzqDa-mYzDRRNeyTb7_3arCnRdhgHgW6","name":"old_ltn_se_base","source":"nihilistzsche/LtnManager issue 58","note":"Very old SE base; fallback only"}
          ]
          JSON

          cat > work/download_parse.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import hashlib, io, json, pathlib, struct, subprocess, zipfile

          P=pathlib.Path
          candidates=json.loads(P('work/candidates.json').read_text())
          results=[]

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self,data): self.data=data; self.offset=0
              def u8(self): v=self.data[self.offset]; self.offset+=1; return v
              def u16(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<H',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=2; return v
              def u32(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<I',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=4; return v
              def version(self): return (self.u16(),self.u16(),self.u16(),self.u16())
              def opt(self,bits,fv):
                  if fv>(0,14,14,0):
                      first=self.u8()
                      if first!=0xff:return first
                  return self.u16() if bits==16 else self.u32()
              def text(self,fv):
                  n=self.opt(32,fv); raw=self.data[self.offset:self.offset+n]; self.offset+=n
                  return raw.decode('utf-8','replace')
              def version48(self,fv): return (self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv))
          def parse_header(data):
              r=Reader(data);fv=r.version();r.u8()
              out={'factorio_version_full':'.'.join(map(str,fv)),'factorio_version':'.'.join(map(str,fv[:3])),'save_name':r.text(fv),'campaign':r.text(fv),'base_mod':r.text(fv)}
              out['difficulty']=r.u8();out['finished']=bool(r.u8());out['player_won']=bool(r.u8());out['next_level']=r.text(fv)
              out['can_continue']=bool(r.u8());out['finished_but_continuing']=bool(r.u8());out['saving_replay']=bool(r.u8());out['allow_non_admin_debug']=bool(r.u8())
              out['loaded_from']='.'.join(map(str,r.version48(fv)));out['loaded_from_build']=r.u32() if fv[0]>=2 else r.u16();out['allowed_commands']=bool(r.u8())
              if fv[0]>=2:r.offset+=4
              mods={}
              for _ in range(r.opt(32,fv)):
                  name=r.text(fv);version='.'.join(map(str,r.version48(fv)));r.u32();mods[name]=version
              out['mods']=mods;return out

          def inspect_zip_bytes(data:bytes, trail:list[str], depth:int=0):
              if depth>3:return None
              try:z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
              except Exception:return None
              with z:
                  names=z.namelist()
                  init=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level-init.dat') or n=='level-init.dat'),None)
                  level=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level.dat') or n=='level.dat'),None)
                  if init and level:
                      return {'data':data,'zip':z,'names':names,'init':init,'trail':trail}
                  nested=[]
                  for info in z.infolist():
                      if info.is_dir() or not info.filename.lower().endswith(('.zip','.sav')):continue
                      if info.file_size<100000 or info.file_size>700000000:continue
                      nested.append(info)
                  nested.sort(key=lambda x:(0 if any(w in x.filename.lower() for w in ('save','space','se','rocket','autosave')) else 1,x.file_size))
                  for info in nested:
                      try:child=z.read(info)
                      except Exception:continue
                      found=inspect_zip_bytes(child,trail+[info.filename],depth+1)
                      if found:return found
              return None

          for c in candidates:
              outer=P('work/downloads')/(c['name']+'.bin');rec=dict(c)
              try:
                  proc=subprocess.run(['gdown','--no-cookies','-O',str(outer),c['id']],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=1200)
                  rec['download_stdout']=proc.stdout[-3000:];rec['download_stderr']=proc.stderr[-3000:]
                  if proc.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError(f'gdown exit {proc.returncode}')
                  if not outer.exists() or outer.stat().st_size<100000:raise RuntimeError('download missing or too small')
                  rec['outer_bytes']=outer.stat().st_size
                  with outer.open('rb') as f: rec['outer_magic']=f.read(32).hex()
                  try:
                      with zipfile.ZipFile(outer) as oz:
                          listing='\n'.join(f'{i.file_size:12d} {i.filename}' for i in oz.infolist())
                          P('published/listings',c['name']+'.txt').write_text(listing)
                  except Exception as exc:
                      rec['outer_listing_error']=repr(exc)
                  data=outer.read_bytes()
                  found=inspect_zip_bytes(data,[outer.name])
                  if not found:raise RuntimeError('no Factorio save found directly or in nested ZIPs')

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')

                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))

                  data += chunk

              return request_id, packet_type, data[8:-2].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

              repos = json.load(response)

          known = [
              'NotAFreak/.factorio', 'Sebastian-Schuchmann/factorio-saves',

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self, data): self.data=data; self.offset=0
              def u8(self): v=self.data[self.offset]; self.offset+=1; return v
              def u16(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<H',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=2; return v
              def u32(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<I',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=4; return v

              def version48(self,fv): return (self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv))
          def header(data):
              r=Reader(data); fv=r.version(); r.u8()
              out={'factorio_version':'.'.join(map(str,fv)),'save_name':r.string(fv),'campaign':r.string(fv),'base_mod':r.string(fv)}

          def run(args,cwd=None,timeout=600,check=True):
              return subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,check=check)

          results=[]; errors=[]; seen_global=set(); bytes_materialized=0
          for repo_index,repo in enumerate(repos):

                      if 10_000_000<=size<=120_000_000:score+=8

              sized.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1]))

                      with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp) as zf:

                          if not init or not level:raise RuntimeError('not Factorio save')
                          h=header(zf.read(init));se=h['mods'].get('space-exploration')
                          rec={'repo':full,'path':path,'blob_sha':sha,'bytes':size,'score':score,'header':h,'se_version':se,'k2_version':h['mods'].get('Krastorio2')}
                          script_name=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/script.dat') or n=='script.dat'),None)
                          if script_name:
                              script=zf.read(script_name)
                              rec['marker_counts']={label:script.count(marker) for label,marker in {
                                  'rocket_science':b'se-rocket-science-pack','launch_pad':b'se-rocket-launch-pad','cargo_section':b'se-cargo-rocket-section','nauvis_orbit':b'Nauvis Orbit','space_lab':b'se-space-science-lab','space_scaffold':b'se-space-platform-scaffold'}.items()}
                          results.append(rec)
                          if str(se).startswith('0.7.'):
                              outname=re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+','_',f'{full}__{path}__{sha[:10]}')[-190:]
                              if size<95_000_000:
                                  shutil.copy2(tmp,PUB/'candidates'/outname);rec['published_copy']='candidates/'+outname
                              preview=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/preview.jpg') or n=='preview.jpg'),None)
                              if preview:

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')
              length = struct.unpack('<i', header)[0]; data = b''
              while len(data) < length:
                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))
                  if not chunk: raise RuntimeError('RCON connection closed')
                  data += chunk
              request_id, packet_type = struct.unpack_from('<ii', data, 0)
              return request_id, packet_type, data[8:-2].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

          for _, force in pairs(game.forces) do if force.name ~= "enemy" and force.name ~= "neutral" then real_forces[force.name] = true end end
          for _, force in pairs(game.forces) do
            local row = {name=force.name, rockets_launched=force.rockets_launched or 0, rocket_science_output=0, rocket_science_input=0, researched={}}
            local ok1, value1 = pcall(function() return force.item_production_statistics.get_output_count("se-rocket-science-pack") end)

          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          import json, re, subprocess, pathlib, time

          queries = [
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 save game",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 pre space",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough",
          ]
          exact_ids = ["dDyBD4oE5Qg"]
          candidates = {}

          def run(args, timeout=180):
              return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)

          for q in queries:
              result = run(["yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-json", f"ytsearch40:{q}"], timeout=240)
              pathlib.Path("published/search-stderr.txt").open("a").write(result.stderr)
              for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
                  try:
                      obj = json.loads(line)
                  except Exception:
                      continue
                  vid = obj.get("id")
                  if not vid:
                      continue
                  title = obj.get("title") or ""
                  candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": title, "queries": []})["queries"].append(q)

          for vid in exact_ids:
              candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": "", "queries": ["exact known lead"]})

          # Prioritize titles that are plausibly around the target checkpoint.
          target_words = (
              "rocket", "space", "orbit", "science", "cargo", "launch", "preparation",
              "first space", "nauvis", "automation", "automating"
          )
          ordered = sorted(
              candidates.values(),
              key=lambda x: (0 if any(w in x["title"].lower() for w in target_words) else 1, x["title"].lower())
          )[:120]

          url_re = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"']+")
          file_host_re = re.compile(
              r"(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|onedrive\.live\.com|1drv\.ms|mega\.nz|"
              r"mediafire\.com|github\.com|gitlab\.com|patreon\.com|ko-fi\.com|factorio\.com|refactorio\.de|"
              r"\.zip(?:[?&#]|$))",
              re.I,
          )
          results = []

          for index, item in enumerate(ordered):
              vid = item["id"]
              url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}"
              proc = run([
                  "yt-dlp", "--skip-download", "--no-warnings", "--dump-single-json", url
              ], timeout=180)
              rec = dict(item)
              rec["url"] = url
              rec["metadata_error"] = proc.stderr[-2000:] if proc.returncode else ""
              if proc.returncode == 0:
                  try:
                      meta = json.loads(proc.stdout)
                  except Exception as exc:
                      rec["metadata_error"] = repr(exc)
                  else:
                      desc = meta.get("description") or ""
                      rec.update({
                          "title": meta.get("title") or rec["title"],
                          "channel": meta.get("channel") or meta.get("uploader"),
                          "upload_date": meta.get("upload_date"),
                          "duration": meta.get("duration"),
                          "description": desc,
                          "external_urls": url_re.findall(desc),
                      })
                      rec["potential_save_links"] = [u.rstrip(".,;:!?") for u in rec["external_urls"] if file_host_re.search(u)]
              results.append(rec)
              if index % 20 == 19:
                  time.sleep(2)

          pathlib.Path("published/youtube-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
          links = []
          for r in results:
              for link in r.get("potential_save_links", []):
                  links.append({
                      "video_id": r["id"],
                      "title": r.get("title"),
                      "channel": r.get("channel"),
                      "upload_date": r.get("upload_date"),
                      "video_url": r.get("url"),
                      "link": link,
                  })
          pathlib.Path("published/potential-save-links.json").write_text(json.dumps(links, indent=2))
          pathlib.Path("published/potential-save-links.txt").write_text("\n".join(
              f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}\n{x['video_url']}\n{x['link']}\n"
              for x in links
          ))

          # Preserve the exact Bold Viking result separately for easy inspection.
          bold = [r for r in results if r["id"] == "dDyBD4oE5Qg"]
          pathlib.Path("published/bold-viking.json").write_text(json.dumps(bold, indent=2))
          print(f"videos={len(results)} potential_links={len(links)}")
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/summary.txt

          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, time, urllib.error, urllib.parse, urllib.request

          OUT = pathlib.Path('published')
          UA = {'User-Agent': 'JJ-SE-save-search/1.0 (public speedrun data research)'}
          errors = []

          def get_json(url: str, attempts: int = 6):
              for attempt in range(attempts):
                  try:
                      req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as response:
                          return json.load(response)
                  except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                      if exc.code in (420, 429, 502, 503, 504) and attempt + 1 < attempts:
                          time.sleep(3 * (attempt + 1)); continue
                      raise
                  except Exception:
                      if attempt + 1 < attempts:
                          time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1)); continue
                      raise

          API = 'https://www.speedrun.com/api/v1'
          game_queries = ['Factorio', 'Factorio Category Extensions', 'Space Exploration']
          games = {}
          for name in game_queries:
              url = API + '/games?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'name': name, 'max': 200})
              try:
                  for game in get_json(url).get('data', []):
                      international = (game.get('names') or {}).get('international', '')
                      if 'factorio' in international.lower() or international.lower() == 'space exploration':
                          games[game['id']] = game
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'game-search', 'name': name, 'error': repr(exc)})

          # Pull derived/category-extension games from every Factorio match.
          for game in list(games.values()):
              try:
                  data = get_json(API + f"/games/{game['id']}/derived-games").get('data', [])
                  for derived in data:
                      games[derived['id']] = derived
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'derived-games', 'game': game['id'], 'error': repr(exc)})

          categories = {}
          variables = {}
          matching_category_ids = set()
          matching_value_filters = []
          text_hits = []

          def contains_se(text: str) -> bool:
              low = (text or '').lower()
              return ('space exploration' in low or 'space-exploration' in low or
                      re.search(r'(^|[^a-z0-9])se\s*0?[67]([^a-z0-9]|$)', low) is not None)

          for game in games.values():
              gid = game['id']
              try:
                  cats = get_json(API + f'/games/{gid}/categories?max=200').get('data', [])
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'categories', 'game': gid, 'error': repr(exc)})
                  continue
              for cat in cats:
                  cat['_game'] = gid
                  categories[cat['id']] = cat
                  combined = ' '.join([cat.get('name') or '', cat.get('rules') or '', cat.get('weblink') or ''])
                  if contains_se(combined):
                      matching_category_ids.add(cat['id'])
                      text_hits.append({'type': 'category', 'game': gid, 'category': cat})
              try:
                  vars_ = get_json(API + f'/games/{gid}/variables?max=200').get('data', [])
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'variables', 'game': gid, 'error': repr(exc)})
                  vars_ = []
              for var in vars_:
                  var['_game'] = gid
                  variables[var['id']] = var
                  if contains_se((var.get('name') or '') + ' ' + (var.get('description') or '')):
                      text_hits.append({'type': 'variable', 'game': gid, 'variable': var})
                  values = ((var.get('values') or {}).get('values') or {})
                  for value_id, value in values.items():
                      label = value.get('label') or ''
                      rules = value.get('rules') or ''
                      if contains_se(label + ' ' + rules):
                          matching_value_filters.append({'game': gid, 'variable': var['id'], 'value': value_id, 'label': label, 'rules': rules, 'category': var.get('category')})
                          text_hits.append({'type': 'value', 'game': gid, 'variable_id': var['id'], 'value_id': value_id, 'label': label, 'rules': rules})
                          if var.get('category'):
                              matching_category_ids.add(var['category'])

          # Fetch every run for Factorio-family games. There are only a few thousand.
          all_runs = []
          for game in games.values():
              gid = game['id']
              offset = 0
              while True:
                  url = API + '/runs?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'game': gid, 'max': 200, 'offset': offset, 'orderby': 'submitted', 'direction': 'desc'})
                  try:
                      page = get_json(url).get('data', [])
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage': 'runs', 'game': gid, 'offset': offset, 'error': repr(exc)})
                      break
                  all_runs.extend(page)
                  if len(page) < 200: break
                  offset += len(page)
                  time.sleep(0.7)

          url_re = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"\']+')
          file_re = re.compile(r'(?:\.zip(?:[?&#]|$)|\.7z(?:[?&#]|$)|\.rar(?:[?&#]|$)|\.sav(?:[?&#]|$)|drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|github\.com/.*/(?:releases|raw|blob)|archive\.org)', re.I)
          evidence_words = re.compile(r'\b(save|savegame|save file|replay|factorio zip|map download)\b', re.I)

          candidates = []
          for run in all_runs:
              cat_id = run.get('category')
              values = run.get('values') or {}
              exact_se_value = any(values.get(f['variable']) == f['value'] for f in matching_value_filters)
              comment = run.get('comment') or ''
              videos = ((run.get('videos') or {}).get('links') or [])
              video_uris = [v.get('uri') for v in videos if v.get('uri')]
              urls = [u.rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(comment)]
              linked_files = [u for u in urls if file_re.search(u)]
              likely_se = cat_id in matching_category_ids or exact_se_value or contains_se(comment)
              evidence = bool(linked_files or evidence_words.search(comment))
              if likely_se or evidence:
                  candidates.append({
                      'id': run.get('id'), 'weblink': run.get('weblink'), 'game': run.get('game'),
                      'category': cat_id, 'date': run.get('date'), 'submitted': run.get('submitted'),
                      'status': run.get('status'), 'times': run.get('times'), 'players': run.get('players'),
                      'values': values, 'comment': comment, 'video_uris': video_uris,
                      'urls': urls, 'linked_files': linked_files, 'likely_space_exploration': likely_se,
                      'matched_category': cat_id in matching_category_ids, 'matched_value': exact_se_value,
                  })

          # Try to fetch HTML run pages for likely SE runs because file links may be rendered outside API comments.
          for rec in candidates:
              if not rec['likely_space_exploration'] or not rec.get('weblink'): continue
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(rec['weblink'], headers=UA)
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40) as response:
                      html = response.read(4_000_000).decode('utf-8', 'replace')
                  html_urls = [u.replace('\\u0026', '&').replace('&amp;', '&').rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(html)]
                  rec['html_file_links'] = [u for u in html_urls if file_re.search(u)]
              except Exception as exc:
                  rec['html_error'] = repr(exc)

          # Attempt actual downloads of public file-host links where a direct URL is already exposed.
          downloads = []
          dedup_links = []
          seen = set()
          for rec in candidates:
              if not rec['likely_space_exploration']: continue
              for u in rec.get('linked_files', []) + rec.get('html_file_links', []):
                  if u not in seen:
                      seen.add(u); dedup_links.append((rec, u))
          for index, (rec, u) in enumerate(dedup_links[:50]):
              direct = u
              if 'drive.google.com/file/d/' in u:
                  m = re.search(r'/file/d/([^/]+)', u)
                  if m: direct = 'https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=' + m.group(1) + '&export=download&confirm=t'
              elif 'dropbox.com/' in u:
                  direct = re.sub(r'[?&]dl=0', '', u)
                  direct += ('&' if '?' in direct else '?') + 'dl=1'
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(direct, headers=UA)
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as response:
                      data = response.read(200_000_001)
                      ctype = response.headers.get('Content-Type')
                  if len(data) > 200_000_000: raise RuntimeError('file over 200 MB limit')
                  name = f"{index:02d}_{rec['id']}.bin"
                  pathlib.Path('published/downloads', name).write_bytes(data)
                  downloads.append({'run': rec['id'], 'source': u, 'direct': direct, 'bytes': len(data), 'content_type': ctype, 'file': 'downloads/' + name, 'magic': data[:32].hex()})
              except Exception as exc:
                  downloads.append({'run': rec['id'], 'source': u, 'direct': direct, 'error': repr(exc)})

          summary = {
              'games': len(games), 'categories': len(categories), 'variables': len(variables),
              'matching_categories': len(matching_category_ids), 'matching_values': len(matching_value_filters),
              'all_runs': len(all_runs), 'candidate_runs': len(candidates),
              'likely_se_runs': sum(1 for r in candidates if r['likely_space_exploration']),
              'public_file_links': len(dedup_links), 'downloads_attempted': len(downloads),
          }
          OUT.joinpath('games.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(games.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('categories.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(categories.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('variables.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(variables.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('matching-text.json').write_text(json.dumps(text_hits, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('candidate-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(candidates, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('downloads.json').write_text(json.dumps(downloads, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('summary.txt').write_text('\n'.join(f'{k}: {v}' for k,v in summary.items()))
          print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
          PY

          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish findings
        if: always()

        run: |

          git add -f tmp-se-speedrun-search
          git commit -m 'Search Speedrun.com for Space Exploration saves'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"

          import json, re, time, urllib.parse, urllib.request, urllib.error, pathlib, ssl

          ssl._create_default_https_context = ssl._create_unverified_context
          ua = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 SE-save-search/1.0'}
          def get_json(url, timeout=25, data=None, headers=None):
              h = dict(ua)
              if headers: h.update(headers)
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=h)
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                  return json.load(r)

          url_re = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"\']+')
          host_re = re.compile(r'(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|github\.com|gitlab\.com|patreon\.com|ko-fi\.com|refactorio\.de|\.zip(?:[?&#]|$))', re.I)
          queries = [
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science',
              'Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 save game',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
          ]
          exact_ids = {'dDyBD4oE5Qg'}
          errors=[]; instances=[]; videos={}; inspected=[]; links=[]

          # Discover Invidious instances with API enabled.
          try:
              raw = get_json('https://api.invidious.io/instances.json', timeout=30)
              for host, meta in raw:
                  details = meta.get('details') or {}
                  if meta.get('type') == 'https' and details.get('api') and details.get('monitor', {}).get('dailyRatios'):
                      instances.append('https://' + host)
                  elif meta.get('type') == 'https' and details.get('api'):
                      instances.append('https://' + host)
          except Exception as exc:
              errors.append({'stage':'instances','error':repr(exc)})

          # Add known public instances, availability varies by the minute because naturally it does.
          instances += [
              'https://inv.nadeko.net','https://yewtu.be','https://invidious.nerdvpn.de',
              'https://inv.us.projectsegfau.lt','https://invidious.private.coffee',
              'https://invidious.privacyredirect.com','https://iv.ggtyler.dev'
          ]
          seen=set(); instances=[x for x in instances if not (x in seen or seen.add(x))]

          working=[]
          for base in instances[:50]:
              try:
                  data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/stats', timeout=12)
                  if isinstance(data, dict): working.append(base)
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage':'probe','base':base,'error':repr(exc)})
              if len(working) >= 8: break

          for q in queries:
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/search?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'q':q,'type':'video','sort_by':'relevance'}), timeout=20)
                      for item in data[:30]:
                          vid=item.get('videoId')
                          if vid:
                              videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':item.get('title'),'author':item.get('author'),'queries':[]})['queries'].append(q)
                      break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'search','base':base,'query':q,'error':repr(exc)})
          for vid in exact_ids: videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':'','author':'','queries':['exact lead']})

          target_words=('rocket','space','orbit','science','cargo','launch','automation','automating','nauvis')
          ordered=sorted(videos.values(), key=lambda x:(0 if any(w in (x.get('title') or '').lower() for w in target_words) else 1,(x.get('title') or '').lower()))[:180]

          # YouTube Innertube fallback. The WEB client often returns shortDescription without login.
          def youtube_innertube(vid):
              body=json.dumps({'context':{'client':{'clientName':'WEB','clientVersion':'2.20260820.00.00','hl':'en'}},'videoId':vid}).encode()
              return get_json('https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false', timeout=25, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Origin':'https://www.youtube.com'})

          for idx,item in enumerate(ordered):
              vid=item['videoId']; meta=None; source=None
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      meta=get_json(base + '/api/v1/videos/' + vid, timeout=20); source=base; break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'video','base':base,'id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              if meta is None:
                  try:
                      raw=youtube_innertube(vid)
                      vd=raw.get('videoDetails') or {}
                      if vd:
                          meta={'videoId':vid,'title':vd.get('title'),'author':vd.get('author'),'description':vd.get('shortDescription'),'lengthSeconds':vd.get('lengthSeconds')}
                          source='youtube-innertube'
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'innertube','id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              rec=dict(item); rec['source']=source
              if meta:
                  desc=meta.get('description') or meta.get('shortDescription') or ''
                  rec.update({'title':meta.get('title') or rec.get('title'),'author':meta.get('author') or meta.get('authorId') or rec.get('author'),'description':desc,'published':meta.get('publishedText') or meta.get('published'),'lengthSeconds':meta.get('lengthSeconds')})

                      links.append({'videoId':vid,'title':rec.get('title'),'author':rec.get('author'),'url':'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='+vid,'link':u})
              inspected.append(rec)
              if idx%25==24: time.sleep(1)

          pathlib.Path('published/working-instances.json').write_text(json.dumps(working,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(inspected,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(links,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(f"{x['title']} | {x['author']}\n{x['url']}\n{x['link']}" for x in links))
          pathlib.Path('published/exact-bold-viking.json').write_text(json.dumps([x for x in inspected if x['videoId']=='dDyBD4oE5Qg'],indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2))
          summary={'instances_discovered':len(instances),'instances_working':len(working),'videos_found':len(videos),'videos_inspected':len(inspected),'save_links':len(links)}
          pathlib.Path('published/summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

permissions:

    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'

          mkdir -p work published
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-youtube-deep
          mkdir -p tmp-se-youtube-deep

          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

BRANCH: tmp-se-parser-fetch-result-20260825

name: Temporary SE parser fetch and candidate decode

on:
  push:
    branches: [tmp-se-parser-fetch-20260825]

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-parser-fetch-result-20260825

jobs:
  decode:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch parser and decode public candidate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published/parser published/SpaceE-Stuck

          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade gdown construct hornwitser.factorio_tools==0.0.7
          python3 -m pip download --quiet --no-deps --dest published/parser hornwitser.factorio_tools==0.0.7

          python3 - <<'PY'
          import importlib.metadata as md
          import json, pathlib, shutil
          import hornwitser.factorio_tools as package
          root = pathlib.Path(package.__file__).resolve().parent
          shutil.copytree(root, pathlib.Path('published/parser/package_source'), dirs_exist_ok=True)
          meta = {
              'distribution_version': md.version('hornwitser.factorio_tools'),
              'package_root': str(root),
              'files': sorted(str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()),
          }
          pathlib.Path('published/parser/metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2))
          PY

          gdown --no-cookies -O work/SpaceE-Stuck.zip 1BFktsFpRaH8N5IHgbbquS9YHyNXClQxr

          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, pathlib, subprocess, zipfile, traceback
          P = pathlib.Path
          out = P('published/SpaceE-Stuck')
          rec = {}
          try:
              save = P('work/SpaceE-Stuck.zip')
              with zipfile.ZipFile(save) as z:
                  rec['zip_bytes'] = save.stat().st_size
                  rec['zip_entries'] = len(z.namelist())
                  script_name = next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('/script.dat') or n == 'script.dat')
                  level_init_name = next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('/level-init.dat') or n == 'level-init.dat')
                  script = P('work/SpaceE-Stuck.script.dat')
                  script.write_bytes(z.read(script_name))
                  level_init = P('work/SpaceE-Stuck.level-init.dat')
                  level_init.write_bytes(z.read(level_init_name))
                  rec['script_name'] = script_name
                  rec['script_bytes'] = script.stat().st_size
                  rec['level_init_name'] = level_init_name
                  rec['level_init_bytes'] = level_init.stat().st_size

              parsed = P('work/SpaceE-Stuck.script.json')
              proc = subprocess.run([
                  'python3', '-m', 'hornwitser.factorio_tools', 'dat2json',
                  '--input-format', 'script', '-i', str(script), '-o', str(parsed)
              ], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=1800)
              rec['decoder_returncode'] = proc.returncode
              rec['decoder_stdout'] = proc.stdout[-8000:]
              rec['decoder_stderr'] = proc.stderr[-12000:]
              if proc.returncode != 0 or not parsed.exists():
                  raise RuntimeError('dat2json failed')

              rec['json_bytes'] = parsed.stat().st_size
              data = json.loads(parsed.read_text())
              rec['top_type'] = type(data).__name__
              rec['top_keys'] = list(data)[:100] if isinstance(data, dict) else None

              mods = data.get('data', []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
              rec['mod_count'] = len(mods) if isinstance(mods, list) else None
              rec['mod_names'] = [m.get('name') for m in mods if isinstance(m, dict)]

              targets = {}
              for m in mods if isinstance(mods, list) else []:
                  if not isinstance(m, dict):
                      continue
                  name = str(m.get('name', ''))
                  low = name.lower()
                  if 'space-exploration' in low or 'milestone' in low:
                      targets[name] = m
              rec['target_mods'] = list(targets)

              terms = (
                  'se-rocket-science-pack', 'rocket-science', 'rocket science',
                  'se-rocket-launch-pad', 'cargo rocket', 'launch pad',
                  'nauvis orbit', 'orbit', 'satellite', 'surface', 'zone',
                  'spaceship', 'landing pad', 'rocket section', 'milestone'
              )
              key_terms = (
                  'rocket', 'science', 'launch', 'landing', 'orbit', 'satellite',
                  'surface', 'zone', 'spaceship', 'milestone', 'visited', 'discovered'
              )
              hits = []
              stats = {'nodes': 0, 'dicts': 0, 'lists': 0, 'scalars': 0, 'max_depth': 0}

              def scalar_preview(v):
                  if isinstance(v, str):
                      return v[:1000]
                  if isinstance(v, (int, float, bool)) or v is None:
                      return v
                  return None

              def walk(v, path, depth=0):
                  stats['nodes'] += 1
                  stats['max_depth'] = max(stats['max_depth'], depth)
                  if len(hits) >= 100000 or depth > 80:
                      return
                  if isinstance(v, dict):
                      stats['dicts'] += 1
                      for k, x in v.items():
                          p2 = path + [str(k)]
                          kl = str(k).lower()
                          if any(t in kl for t in key_terms):
                              h = {'path': '/'.join(p2), 'match': 'key', 'type': type(x).__name__}
                              if isinstance(x, (str, int, float, bool)) or x is None:
                                  h['value'] = scalar_preview(x)
                              elif hasattr(x, '__len__'):
                                  h['length'] = len(x)
                              hits.append(h)
                          walk(x, p2, depth + 1)
                  elif isinstance(v, list):
                      stats['lists'] += 1
                      for i, x in enumerate(v):
                          walk(x, path + [str(i)], depth + 1)
                  else:
                      stats['scalars'] += 1
                      if isinstance(v, str):
                          vl = v.lower()
                          matching = [t for t in terms if t in vl]
                          if matching:
                              hits.append({
                                  'path': '/'.join(path), 'match': 'value',
                                  'terms': matching, 'type': 'str', 'value': v[:2000]
                              })

              for name, root in targets.items():
                  walk(root, [name])

              rec['walk_stats'] = stats
              rec['hit_count'] = len(hits)
              (out / 'keyword-hits.json').write_text(json.dumps(hits, indent=2))

              # Preserve shallow shape of each target root without flooding the result branch.
              def shape(v, depth=0):
                  if depth >= 5:
                      return {'type': type(v).__name__, 'length': len(v) if hasattr(v, '__len__') else None}
                  if isinstance(v, dict):
                      return {str(k): shape(x, depth + 1) for k, x in list(v.items())[:500]}
                  if isinstance(v, list):
                      return [shape(x, depth + 1) for x in v[:100]]
                  return scalar_preview(v)
              (out / 'target-shapes.json').write_text(json.dumps({k: shape(v) for k, v in targets.items()}, indent=2))

          except Exception as e:
              rec['error'] = repr(e)
              rec['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()

          from __future__ import annotations

            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',

            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:

              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})

          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']

          from __future__ import annotations
          import hashlib, io, json, pathlib, struct, subprocess, zipfile

          P=pathlib.Path
          candidates=json.loads(P('work/candidates.json').read_text())
          results=[]

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self,data): self.data=data; self.offset=0
              def u8(self): v=self.data[self.offset]; self.offset+=1; return v
              def u16(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<H',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=2; return v
              def u32(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<I',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=4; return v
              def version(self): return (self.u16(),self.u16(),self.u16(),self.u16())
              def opt(self,bits,fv):
                  if fv>(0,14,14,0):
                      first=self.u8()
                      if first!=0xff:return first
                  return self.u16() if bits==16 else self.u32()
              def text(self,fv):
                  n=self.opt(32,fv); raw=self.data[self.offset:self.offset+n]; self.offset+=n
                  return raw.decode('utf-8','replace')
              def version48(self,fv): return (self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv))
          def parse_header(data):
              r=Reader(data);fv=r.version();r.u8()
              out={'factorio_version_full':'.'.join(map(str,fv)),'factorio_version':'.'.join(map(str,fv[:3])),'save_name':r.text(fv),'campaign':r.text(fv),'base_mod':r.text(fv)}

              out['loaded_from']='.'.join(map(str,r.version48(fv)));out['loaded_from_build']=r.u32() if fv[0]>=2 else r.u16();out['allowed_commands']=bool(r.u8())
              if fv[0]>=2:r.offset+=4
              mods={}
              for _ in range(r.opt(32,fv)):
                  name=r.text(fv);version='.'.join(map(str,r.version48(fv)));r.u32();mods[name]=version
              out['mods']=mods;return out

          def inspect_zip_bytes(data:bytes, trail:list[str], depth:int=0):
              if depth>3:return None
              try:z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
              except Exception:return None
              with z:
                  names=z.namelist()
                  init=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level-init.dat') or n=='level-init.dat'),None)
                  level=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level.dat') or n=='level.dat'),None)
                  if init and level:
                      return {'data':data,'zip':z,'names':names,'init':init,'trail':trail}
                  nested=[]
                  for info in z.infolist():
                      if info.is_dir() or not info.filename.lower().endswith(('.zip','.sav')):continue
                      if info.file_size<100000 or info.file_size>700000000:continue
                      nested.append(info)
                  nested.sort(key=lambda x:(0 if any(w in x.filename.lower() for w in ('save','space','se','rocket','autosave')) else 1,x.file_size))
                  for info in nested:
                      try:child=z.read(info)
                      except Exception:continue
                      found=inspect_zip_bytes(child,trail+[info.filename],depth+1)
                      if found:return found
              return None

          for c in candidates:
              outer=P('work/downloads')/(c['name']+'.bin');rec=dict(c)
              try:
                  proc=subprocess.run(['gdown','--no-cookies','-O',str(outer),c['id']],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=1200)
                  rec['download_stdout']=proc.stdout[-3000:];rec['download_stderr']=proc.stderr[-3000:]
                  if proc.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError(f'gdown exit {proc.returncode}')
                  if not outer.exists() or outer.stat().st_size<100000:raise RuntimeError('download missing or too small')
                  rec['outer_bytes']=outer.stat().st_size
                  with outer.open('rb') as f: rec['outer_magic']=f.read(32).hex()
                  try:
                      with zipfile.ZipFile(outer) as oz:
                          listing='\n'.join(f'{i.file_size:12d} {i.filename}' for i in oz.infolist())
                          P('published/listings',c['name']+'.txt').write_text(listing)
                  except Exception as exc:
                      rec['outer_listing_error']=repr(exc)
                  data=outer.read_bytes()
                  found=inspect_zip_bytes(data,[outer.name])
                  if not found:raise RuntimeError('no Factorio save found directly or in nested ZIPs')
                  actual=P('work/actual-saves')/(c['name']+'.zip');actual.write_bytes(found['data'])
                  rec['actual_path']=str(actual);rec['nesting_trail']=found['trail'];rec['actual_bytes']=len(found['data'])
                  h=parse_header(found['zip'].read(found['init']));rec['header']=h;rec['se_version']=h['mods'].get('space-exploration');rec['k2_version']=h['mods'].get('Krastorio2');rec['mod_count']=len(h['mods'])
                  script_name=next((n for n in found['names'] if n.endswith('/script.dat') or n=='script.dat'),None)
                  if script_name:
                      script=found['zip'].read(script_name)
                      rec['marker_counts']={label:script.count(marker) for label,marker in {
                          'rocket_science':b'se-rocket-science-pack','launch_pad':b'se-rocket-launch-pad','cargo_section':b'se-cargo-rocket-section','nauvis_orbit':b'Nauvis Orbit','space_lab':b'se-space-science-lab','space_scaffold':b'se-space-platform-scaffold'}.items()}
                  preview=next((n for n in found['names'] if n.endswith('/preview.jpg') or n=='preview.jpg'),None)
                  if preview:
                      out=P('published/previews')/(c['name']+'.jpg');out.write_bytes(found['zip'].read(preview));rec['preview']='previews/'+out.name
                  hasher=hashlib.sha256();
                  with actual.open('rb') as f:
                      for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):hasher.update(chunk)
                  rec['sha256']=hasher.hexdigest()
              except Exception as exc:rec['error']=repr(exc)
              results.append(rec)
          P('published/header-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
          P('published/header-summary.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(f"{r['name']}: outer={r.get('outer_bytes')} actual={r.get('actual_bytes')} trail={r.get('nesting_trail')} Factorio={r.get('header',{}).get('factorio_version')} SE={r.get('se_version')} K2={r.get('k2_version')} error={r.get('error')}\nmarkers={r.get('marker_counts')}" for r in results))
          print(P('published/header-summary.txt').read_text())

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'

          def receive(sock):

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self, data): self.data=data; self.offset=0
              def u8(self): v=self.data[self.offset]; self.offset+=1; return v
              def u16(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<H',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=2; return v
              def u32(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<I',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=4; return v

              def version48(self,fv): return (self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv))
          def header(data):

              out={'factorio_version':'.'.join(map(str,fv)),'save_name':r.string(fv),'campaign':r.string(fv),'base_mod':r.string(fv)}

              if fv[0]>=2:r.offset+=4

                  name=r.string(fv);ver='.'.join(map(str,r.version48(fv)));r.u32();mods[name]=ver
              out['mods']=mods;return out

          def run(args,cwd=None,timeout=600,check=True):
              return subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,check=check)

          results=[]; errors=[]; seen_global=set(); bytes_materialized=0

                      if 10_000_000<=size<=120_000_000:score+=8

              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'

          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          import json, re, subprocess, pathlib, time

          queries = [
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 save game",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 pre space",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough",
          ]
          exact_ids = ["dDyBD4oE5Qg"]
          candidates = {}

          def run(args, timeout=180):
              return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)

          for q in queries:
              result = run(["yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-json", f"ytsearch40:{q}"], timeout=240)
              pathlib.Path("published/search-stderr.txt").open("a").write(result.stderr)
              for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
                  try:
                      obj = json.loads(line)
                  except Exception:
                      continue
                  vid = obj.get("id")
                  if not vid:
                      continue
                  title = obj.get("title") or ""
                  candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": title, "queries": []})["queries"].append(q)

          for vid in exact_ids:
              candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": "", "queries": ["exact known lead"]})

          # Prioritize titles that are plausibly around the target checkpoint.
          target_words = (
              "rocket", "space", "orbit", "science", "cargo", "launch", "preparation",
              "first space", "nauvis", "automation", "automating"
          )
          ordered = sorted(
              candidates.values(),
              key=lambda x: (0 if any(w in x["title"].lower() for w in target_words) else 1, x["title"].lower())
          )[:120]

          url_re = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"']+")
          file_host_re = re.compile(
              r"(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|onedrive\.live\.com|1drv\.ms|mega\.nz|"
              r"mediafire\.com|github\.com|gitlab\.com|patreon\.com|ko-fi\.com|factorio\.com|refactorio\.de|"
              r"\.zip(?:[?&#]|$))",
              re.I,
          )
          results = []

          for index, item in enumerate(ordered):
              vid = item["id"]
              url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}"
              proc = run([
                  "yt-dlp", "--skip-download", "--no-warnings", "--dump-single-json", url
              ], timeout=180)
              rec = dict(item)
              rec["url"] = url
              rec["metadata_error"] = proc.stderr[-2000:] if proc.returncode else ""
              if proc.returncode == 0:
                  try:
                      meta = json.loads(proc.stdout)
                  except Exception as exc:
                      rec["metadata_error"] = repr(exc)
                  else:
                      desc = meta.get("description") or ""
                      rec.update({
                          "title": meta.get("title") or rec["title"],
                          "channel": meta.get("channel") or meta.get("uploader"),
                          "upload_date": meta.get("upload_date"),
                          "duration": meta.get("duration"),
                          "description": desc,
                          "external_urls": url_re.findall(desc),
                      })
                      rec["potential_save_links"] = [u.rstrip(".,;:!?") for u in rec["external_urls"] if file_host_re.search(u)]
              results.append(rec)
              if index % 20 == 19:
                  time.sleep(2)

          pathlib.Path("published/youtube-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
          links = []
          for r in results:
              for link in r.get("potential_save_links", []):
                  links.append({
                      "video_id": r["id"],
                      "title": r.get("title"),
                      "channel": r.get("channel"),
                      "upload_date": r.get("upload_date"),
                      "video_url": r.get("url"),
                      "link": link,
                  })
          pathlib.Path("published/potential-save-links.json").write_text(json.dumps(links, indent=2))
          pathlib.Path("published/potential-save-links.txt").write_text("\n".join(
              f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}\n{x['video_url']}\n{x['link']}\n"
              for x in links
          ))

          # Preserve the exact Bold Viking result separately for easy inspection.
          bold = [r for r in results if r["id"] == "dDyBD4oE5Qg"]
          pathlib.Path("published/bold-viking.json").write_text(json.dumps(bold, indent=2))
          print(f"videos={len(results)} potential_links={len(links)}")
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/summary.txt
