          import json, re, time, urllib.parse, urllib.request, urllib.error, pathlib, ssl

          ssl._create_default_https_context = ssl._create_unverified_context
          ua = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 SE-save-search/1.0'}
          def get_json(url, timeout=25, data=None, headers=None):
              h = dict(ua)
              if headers: h.update(headers)
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=h)
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                  return json.load(r)

          url_re = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"\']+')
          host_re = re.compile(r'(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|github\.com|gitlab\.com|patreon\.com|ko-fi\.com|refactorio\.de|\.zip(?:[?&#]|$))', re.I)
          queries = [
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science',
              'Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 save game',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
          ]
          exact_ids = {'dDyBD4oE5Qg'}
          errors=[]; instances=[]; videos={}; inspected=[]; links=[]

          # Discover Invidious instances with API enabled.
          try:
              raw = get_json('https://api.invidious.io/instances.json', timeout=30)
              for host, meta in raw:
                  details = meta.get('details') or {}
                  if meta.get('type') == 'https' and details.get('api') and details.get('monitor', {}).get('dailyRatios'):
                      instances.append('https://' + host)
                  elif meta.get('type') == 'https' and details.get('api'):
                      instances.append('https://' + host)
          except Exception as exc:
              errors.append({'stage':'instances','error':repr(exc)})

          # Add known public instances, availability varies by the minute because naturally it does.
          instances += [
              'https://inv.nadeko.net','https://yewtu.be','https://invidious.nerdvpn.de',
              'https://inv.us.projectsegfau.lt','https://invidious.private.coffee',
              'https://invidious.privacyredirect.com','https://iv.ggtyler.dev'
          ]
          seen=set(); instances=[x for x in instances if not (x in seen or seen.add(x))]

          working=[]
          for base in instances[:50]:
              try:
                  data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/stats', timeout=12)
                  if isinstance(data, dict): working.append(base)
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage':'probe','base':base,'error':repr(exc)})
              if len(working) >= 8: break

          for q in queries:
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/search?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'q':q,'type':'video','sort_by':'relevance'}), timeout=20)
                      for item in data[:30]:
                          vid=item.get('videoId')
                          if vid:
                              videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':item.get('title'),'author':item.get('author'),'queries':[]})['queries'].append(q)
                      break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'search','base':base,'query':q,'error':repr(exc)})
          for vid in exact_ids: videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':'','author':'','queries':['exact lead']})

          target_words=('rocket','space','orbit','science','cargo','launch','automation','automating','nauvis')
          ordered=sorted(videos.values(), key=lambda x:(0 if any(w in (x.get('title') or '').lower() for w in target_words) else 1,(x.get('title') or '').lower()))[:180]

          # YouTube Innertube fallback. The WEB client often returns shortDescription without login.
          def youtube_innertube(vid):
              body=json.dumps({'context':{'client':{'clientName':'WEB','clientVersion':'2.20260820.00.00','hl':'en'}},'videoId':vid}).encode()
              return get_json('https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false', timeout=25, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Origin':'https://www.youtube.com'})

          for idx,item in enumerate(ordered):
              vid=item['videoId']; meta=None; source=None
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      meta=get_json(base + '/api/v1/videos/' + vid, timeout=20); source=base; break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'video','base':base,'id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              if meta is None:
                  try:
                      raw=youtube_innertube(vid)
                      vd=raw.get('videoDetails') or {}
                      if vd:
                          meta={'videoId':vid,'title':vd.get('title'),'author':vd.get('author'),'description':vd.get('shortDescription'),'lengthSeconds':vd.get('lengthSeconds')}
                          source='youtube-innertube'
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'innertube','id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              rec=dict(item); rec['source']=source
              if meta:
                  desc=meta.get('description') or meta.get('shortDescription') or ''
                  rec.update({'title':meta.get('title') or rec.get('title'),'author':meta.get('author') or meta.get('authorId') or rec.get('author'),'description':desc,'published':meta.get('publishedText') or meta.get('published'),'lengthSeconds':meta.get('lengthSeconds')})
                  urls=[u.rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(desc)]
                  rec['urls']=urls; rec['potential_save_links']=[u for u in urls if host_re.search(u)]
                  for u in rec['potential_save_links']:
                      links.append({'videoId':vid,'title':rec.get('title'),'author':rec.get('author'),'url':'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='+vid,'link':u})
              inspected.append(rec)
              if idx%25==24: time.sleep(1)

          pathlib.Path('published/working-instances.json').write_text(json.dumps(working,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(inspected,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(links,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(f"{x['title']} | {x['author']}\n{x['url']}\n{x['link']}" for x in links))
          pathlib.Path('published/exact-bold-viking.json').write_text(json.dumps([x for x in inspected if x['videoId']=='dDyBD4oE5Qg'],indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2))
          summary={'instances_discovered':len(instances),'instances_working':len(working),'videos_found':len(videos),'videos_inspected':len(inspected),'save_links':len(links)}
          pathlib.Path('published/summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          PY

BRANCH: tmp-se-save-fetch-20260824
PATH: .github/workflows/tmp-se-save-fetch.yml
SIZE: 16950 | TARGET_HITS: 40 | STAGE_HITS: 14
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: Inspect RedMew SE 0.7 candidate

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - tmp-se-save-fetch-20260824

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-redmew-result-20260824
  SAVE_URL: "https://refactorio.de/saves?directory=public%2Ffinal&file=se_crash.zip"

jobs:
  inspect:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download and inspect save header
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work/mods published/chunks published/preview
          curl --fail --location --retry 8 --retry-all-errors \
            --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 1800 \
            --output work/candidate.zip "$SAVE_URL"
          test "$(stat -c %s work/candidate.zip)" -gt 1000000
          unzip -t work/candidate.zip > published/unzip-test.txt
          unzip -l work/candidate.zip > published/file-list.txt
          sha256sum work/candidate.zip > published/save-sha256.txt

          cat > work/setup.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import hashlib, json, pathlib, random, struct, tarfile, urllib.parse, urllib.request, zipfile

          P = pathlib.Path
          with zipfile.ZipFile('work/candidate.zip') as zf:
              names = zf.namelist()
              init = next(n for n in names if n.endswith('/level-init.dat') or n == 'level-init.dat')
              data = zf.read(init)
              preview = next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/preview.jpg') or n == 'preview.jpg'), None)
              if preview:
                  P('published/preview/preview.jpg').write_bytes(zf.read(preview))
              script = next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/script.dat') or n == 'script.dat'), None)
              marker_counts = {}
              if script:
                  blob = zf.read(script)
                  markers = {
                      'rocket_science': b'se-rocket-science-pack',
                      'launch_pad': b'se-rocket-launch-pad',
                      'cargo_section': b'se-cargo-rocket-section',
                      'nauvis_orbit': b'Nauvis Orbit',
                      'space_lab': b'se-space-science-lab',
                      'space_scaffold': b'se-space-platform-scaffold',
                  }
                  marker_counts = {k: blob.count(v) for k, v in markers.items()}

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self, data): self.data, self.offset = data, 0
              def u8(self): value = self.data[self.offset]; self.offset += 1; return value
              def u16(self): value = struct.unpack_from('<H', self.data, self.offset)[0]; self.offset += 2; return value
              def u32(self): value = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.data, self.offset)[0]; self.offset += 4; return value
              def version(self): return self.u16(), self.u16(), self.u16(), self.u16()
              def optimized(self, bits, fv):
                  if fv > (0, 14, 14, 0):
                      value = self.u8()
                      if value != 255: return value
                  return self.u16() if bits == 16 else self.u32()
              def text(self, fv):
                  length = self.optimized(32, fv)
                  value = self.data[self.offset:self.offset + length]
                  self.offset += length
                  return value.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
              def version48(self, fv): return self.optimized(16, fv), self.optimized(16, fv), self.optimized(16, fv)

          reader = Reader(data)
          fv = reader.version(); reader.u8()
          header = {
              'factorio_version': '.'.join(map(str, fv[:3])),
              'factorio_version_full': '.'.join(map(str, fv)),
              'save_name': reader.text(fv),
              'campaign': reader.text(fv),
              'base_mod': reader.text(fv),
          }
          header['difficulty'] = reader.u8(); header['finished'] = bool(reader.u8()); header['player_won'] = bool(reader.u8())
          header['next_level'] = reader.text(fv); header['can_continue'] = bool(reader.u8()); header['finished_but_continuing'] = bool(reader.u8())
          header['saving_replay'] = bool(reader.u8()); header['allow_non_admin_debug'] = bool(reader.u8())
          header['loaded_from'] = '.'.join(map(str, reader.version48(fv)))
          header['loaded_from_build'] = reader.u32() if fv[0] >= 2 else reader.u16(); header['allowed_commands'] = bool(reader.u8())
          if fv[0] >= 2: reader.offset += 4
          mods = {}
          for _ in range(reader.optimized(32, fv)):
              name = reader.text(fv); version = '.'.join(map(str, reader.version48(fv))); reader.u32(); mods[name] = version
          header['mods'] = mods
          header['marker_counts'] = marker_counts
          P('published/header.json').write_text(json.dumps(header, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

          def download(url: str, destination: P, timeout: int = 1200):
              request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'FactorioModDownloader/0.5.0'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response, destination.open('wb') as target:
                  while True:
                      chunk = response.read(1024 * 1024)
                      if not chunk: break
                      target.write(chunk)

          factorio_archive = P('work/factorio.tar.xz')
          download(f"https://factorio.com/get-download/{header['factorio_version']}/headless/linux64", factorio_archive)
          with tarfile.open(factorio_archive, 'r:xz') as archive: archive.extractall('work')

          report = []
          for name, version in mods.items():
              if name in {'base', 'core'}:
                  report.append({'name': name, 'version': version, 'status': 'builtin'})
                  continue
              destination = P('work/mods') / f'{name}_{version}.zip'
              encoded_name = urllib.parse.quote(name, safe='')
              encoded_version = urllib.parse.quote(version, safe='')
              candidates = [
                  f'https://mods-storage.re146.dev/{encoded_name}/{encoded_version}.zip?anticache={random.random()}',
                  f'https://dl-mod.factorio.com/{encoded_name}/{encoded_version}.zip',
              ]
              failure = None
              for url in candidates:
                  try:
                      download(url, destination)
                      with zipfile.ZipFile(destination) as archive:
                          if not archive.namelist(): raise RuntimeError('empty ZIP')
                      report.append({'name': name, 'version': version, 'status': 'downloaded', 'bytes': destination.stat().st_size, 'url': url.split('?')[0]})
                      failure = None
                      break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      failure = repr(exc); destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)
              if failure:
                  report.append({'name': name, 'version': version, 'status': 'failed', 'error': failure})
          P('published/mod-downloads.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
          P('work/mods/mod-list.json').write_text(json.dumps({'mods': [{'name': name, 'enabled': True} for name in mods]}, indent=2))
          failures = [entry for entry in report if entry['status'] == 'failed']
          P('published/mod-failure-count.txt').write_text(str(len(failures)) + '\n')
          if failures: raise SystemExit(f'{len(failures)} exact mod downloads failed')
          PY
          python3 work/setup.py | tee published/setup-console.txt

      - name: Headless-load and query progression
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > work/server-settings.json <<'JSON'
          {"name":"inspection","visibility":{"public":false,"lan":false},"require_user_verification":false,"max_players":0,"autosave_interval":0,"allow_commands":"admins-only"}
          JSON
          work/factorio/bin/x64/factorio \
            --start-server work/candidate.zip \
            --mod-directory work/mods \
            --server-settings work/server-settings.json \
            --rcon-port 27500 --rcon-password inspect \
            > published/server.log 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          echo "$SERVER_PID" > work/server.pid

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')
              length = struct.unpack('<i', header)[0]; data = b''
              while len(data) < length:
                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))
                  if not chunk: raise RuntimeError('RCON connection closed')
                  data += chunk
              request_id, packet_type = struct.unpack_from('<ii', data, 0)
              return request_id, packet_type, data[8:-2].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

          end
          for _, player in pairs(game.players) do table.insert(report.players, {name=player.name, force=player.force.name, surface=player.surface and player.surface.name or nil, position=player.position}) end
          for _, surface in pairs(game.surfaces) do
            local row = {name=surface.name, index=surface.index, chunks=0, player_entities=0, entities={}, rocket_science_machines=0}
            for _ in surface.get_chunks() do row.chunks = row.chunks + 1 end

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')
              length = struct.unpack('<i', header)[0]; data = b''
              while len(data) < length:
                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))
                  if not chunk: raise RuntimeError('RCON connection closed')
                  data += chunk
              request_id, packet_type = struct.unpack_from('<ii', data, 0)
              return request_id, packet_type, data[8:-2].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

          end
          for _, player in pairs(game.players) do table.insert(report.players, {name=player.name, force=player.force.name, surface=player.surface and player.surface.name or nil, position=player.position}) end
          for _, surface in pairs(game.surfaces) do
            local row = {name=surface.name, index=surface.index, chunks=0, player_entities=0, entities={}, rocket_science_machines=0}

          api_headers = {
              'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}',
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
              'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
              'User-Agent': 'SE-save-finder/1.0',
          }
          raw_headers = {'User-Agent': 'SE-save-finder/1.0'}

          def api(url: str):
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=api_headers)
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as r:
                  return json.load(r)

          queries = [
              'factorio save pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio saves pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio-save pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio_saves pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio in:name save in:name pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio backup pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              '"Space Exploration" factorio pushed:>=2025-09-22',
          ]
          repos = {}
          search_errors = []
          for q in queries:
              for page in range(1, 6):
                  url = 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({
                      'q': q, 'per_page': 100, 'page': page, 'sort': 'updated', 'order': 'desc'
                  })
                  try:
                      data = api(url)
                  except Exception as exc:
                      search_errors.append({'query': q, 'page': page, 'error': repr(exc)})
                      break
                  items = data.get('items', [])
                  for item in items:
                      repos[item['full_name']] = {
                          'full_name': item['full_name'],
                          'default_branch': item.get('default_branch') or 'main',
                          'size_kb': item.get('size', 0),
                          'description': item.get('description'),
                          'pushed_at': item.get('pushed_at'),
                          'html_url': item.get('html_url'),
                      }
                  if len(items) < 100:
                      break
                  time.sleep(0.3)

          # Known repos that broad search sometimes omits.
          for full in [
              'NotAFreak/.factorio', 'Sebastian-Schuchmann/factorio-saves',
              'j4yu22/factorio-save', 'luis-navarro1/factorio_saves',
              'Frogo-o/factorio-saves', 'ChristineZhiMei/FACTORIO_SAVES',
              'syedimran23/factorio-multiplayer-saves', 'ianic-dev/factorio-saves',
          ]:
              if full not in repos:
                  try:
                      item = api('https://api.github.com/repos/' + full)
                      repos[full] = {
                          'full_name': full,
                          'default_branch': item.get('default_branch') or 'main',
                          'size_kb': item.get('size', 0),
                          'description': item.get('description'),
                          'pushed_at': item.get('pushed_at'),
                          'html_url': item.get('html_url'),
                      }
                  except Exception as exc:
                      search_errors.append({'repo': full, 'error': repr(exc)})

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self, data: bytes): self.data, self.offset = data, 0
              def u8(self):
                  v = self.data[self.offset]; self.offset += 1; return v
              def u16(self):
                  v = struct.unpack_from('<H', self.data, self.offset)[0]; self.offset += 2; return v
              def u32(self):
                  v = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.data, self.offset)[0]; self.offset += 4; return v
              def version(self): return (self.u16(), self.u16(), self.u16(), self.u16())
              def opt(self, bits, fv):
                  if fv > (0, 14, 14, 0):
                      first = self.u8()
                      if first != 0xff: return first
                  return self.u16() if bits == 16 else self.u32()
              def string(self, fv):
                  n = self.opt(32, fv)
                  raw = self.data[self.offset:self.offset+n]; self.offset += n
                  return raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
              def version48(self, fv): return (self.opt(16, fv), self.opt(16, fv), self.opt(16, fv))

          def parse_header(data: bytes):
              r = Reader(data); fv = r.version(); r.u8()
              result = {
                  'factorio_version': '.'.join(map(str, fv)),
                  'save_name': r.string(fv), 'campaign': r.string(fv), 'base_mod': r.string(fv),
              }
              r.u8(); r.u8(); r.u8(); r.string(fv); r.u8(); r.u8(); r.u8(); r.u8()
              result['loaded_from'] = '.'.join(map(str, r.version48(fv)))
              result['loaded_from_build'] = r.u32() if fv[0] >= 2 else r.u16()
              r.u8()
              if fv[0] >= 2: r.offset += 4
              count = r.opt(32, fv)
              mods = {}
              for _ in range(count):
                  name = r.string(fv); ver = '.'.join(map(str, r.version48(fv))); r.u32(); mods[name] = ver
              result['mods'] = mods
              return result

          tree_errors = []
          blobs = []
          for idx, repo in enumerate(repos.values()):
              full = repo['full_name']; branch = repo['default_branch']
              try:
                  branch_data = api(f'https://api.github.com/repos/{full}/branches/{urllib.parse.quote(branch, safe="")}')
                  tree_sha = branch_data['commit']['commit']['tree']['sha']
                  tree = api(f'https://api.github.com/repos/{full}/git/trees/{tree_sha}?recursive=1')
              except Exception as exc:
                  tree_errors.append({'repo': full, 'error': repr(exc)})
                  continue
              for item in tree.get('tree', []):
                  if item.get('type') != 'blob': continue
                  path = item.get('path', '')
                  size = item.get('size') or 0
                  if not path.lower().endswith('.zip'): continue
                  if size < 100_000 or size > 180_000_000: continue
                  score = 0
                  low = (full + '/' + path + ' ' + (repo.get('description') or '')).lower()
                  for word, points in [
                      ('space-exploration', 40), ('space exploration', 40), ('se0.7', 35), ('se07', 35),
                      ('rocket', 20), ('space', 12), ('save', 8), ('autosave', 7), ('factorio', 3),
                  ]:
                      if word in low: score += points
                  # Medium-sized saves are more plausible around the requested checkpoint.
                  mb = size / 1_000_000
                  if 15 <= mb <= 100: score += 8
                  blobs.append({**repo, 'path': path, 'blob_sha': item['sha'], 'bytes': size, 'score': score})
              if idx % 50 == 49: time.sleep(0.5)

          blobs.sort(key=lambda x: (-x['score'], x['bytes']))
          # Bound bandwidth. Prefer promising paths, but still sample generic repositories.
          selected = blobs[:350]
          download_errors = []
          records = []
          total_bytes = 0
          native = []
          for i, item in enumerate(selected):
              if total_bytes > 7_000_000_000: break
              full, branch, path = item['full_name'], item['default_branch'], item['path']
              raw_url = f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{full}/{urllib.parse.quote(branch, safe="")}/{urllib.parse.quote(path, safe="/")}'
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(raw_url, headers=raw_headers)
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=240) as r:
                      data = r.read(180_000_001)
                  if len(data) > 180_000_000:
                      raise RuntimeError('download exceeded limit')
                  total_bytes += len(data)
                  if data.startswith(b'version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec'):
                      raise RuntimeError('Git LFS pointer, not save bytes')
                  with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as zf:
                      names = zf.namelist()
                      init = next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level-init.dat') or n == 'level-init.dat'), None)
                      level = next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level.dat') or n == 'level.dat'), None)
                      if not init or not level:
                          raise RuntimeError('not a Factorio save ZIP')
                      header = parse_header(zf.read(init))
                      mods = header['mods']
                      script_name = next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/script.dat') or n == 'script.dat'), None)
                      marker_counts = {}
                      if script_name:
                          script = zf.read(script_name)
                          for label, marker in {
                              'rocket_science': b'se-rocket-science-pack',
                              'launch_pad': b'se-rocket-launch-pad',
                              'cargo_section': b'se-cargo-rocket-section',
                              'nauvis_orbit': b'Nauvis Orbit',
                              'space_lab': b'se-space-science-lab',
                              'space_scaffold': b'se-space-platform-scaffold',
                          }.items(): marker_counts[label] = script.count(marker)
                      rec = {
                          **item, 'raw_url': raw_url, 'downloaded_bytes': len(data),
                          'factorio_save': True, 'header': header, 'marker_counts': marker_counts,
                          'se_version': mods.get('space-exploration'),
                          'k2_version': mods.get('Krastorio2'),
                      }
                      records.append(rec)
                      if str(rec['se_version']).startswith('0.7.'):
                          native.append(rec)
                          safe = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+', '_', f'{full}__{path}')[-180:]
                          # Keep actual bytes only when GitHub can store them.
                          if len(data) < 95_000_000:
                              Path('published/candidates', safe).write_bytes(data)
                              rec['published_copy'] = 'candidates/' + safe
                          preview_name = next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/preview.jpg') or n == 'preview.jpg'), None)
                          if preview_name:
                              Path('published/previews', safe + '.jpg').write_bytes(zf.read(preview_name))
                              rec['published_preview'] = 'previews/' + safe + '.jpg'
              except Exception as exc:
                  download_errors.append({**item, 'raw_url': raw_url, 'error': repr(exc)})
              if i % 20 == 19: time.sleep(0.5)

          # Re-write after published_copy / preview additions.
          Path('published/native-se07-candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(native, indent=2))
          Path('published/all-valid-factorio-saves.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2))
          Path('published/repositories.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(repos.values()), indent=2))
          Path('published/all-zip-blobs.json').write_text(json.dumps(blobs, indent=2))
          Path('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps({
              'search': search_errors, 'tree': tree_errors, 'download': download_errors
          }, indent=2))
          summary = {
              'repositories': len(repos), 'zip_blobs': len(blobs), 'selected_for_download': len(selected),
              'downloaded_bytes': total_bytes, 'valid_factorio_saves': len(records),
              'native_se07_saves': len(native),
          }
          Path('published/summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
          Path('published/summary.txt').write_text('\n'.join(f'{k}: {v}' for k,v in summary.items()))
          print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

              def u32(self): value = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.data, self.offset)[0]; self.offset += 4; return value

              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response, destination.open('wb') as target:
                  while True:
                      chunk = response.read(1024 * 1024)

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')
              length = struct.unpack('<i', header)[0]; data = b''
              while len(data) < length:
                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))
                  if not chunk: raise RuntimeError('RCON connection closed')
                  data += chunk
              request_id, packet_type = struct.unpack_from('<ii', data, 0)
              return request_id, packet_type, data[8:-2].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

          lua = r'''
          local report = {tick=game.tick, hours=game.tick/216000, players={}, forces={}, surfaces={}, recipes={}, rocket_science_machines=0, rocket_science_working=0, rocket_science_support={}}
          local real_forces = {}
          for _, force in pairs(game.forces) do if force.name ~= "enemy" and force.name ~= "neutral" then real_forces[force.name] = true end end
          for _, force in pairs(game.forces) do
            local row = {name=force.name, rockets_launched=force.rockets_launched or 0, rocket_science_output=0, rocket_science_input=0, researched={}}
            local ok1, value1 = pcall(function() return force.item_production_statistics.get_output_count("se-rocket-science-pack") end)
            if ok1 then row.rocket_science_output = value1 end
            local ok2, value2 = pcall(function() return force.item_production_statistics.get_input_count("se-rocket-science-pack") end)
            if ok2 then row.rocket_science_input = value2 end
            for name, tech in pairs(force.technologies) do
              if tech.researched and (string.find(name, "rocket", 1, true) or string.find(name, "space", 1, true)) then table.insert(row.researched, name) end
            end
            table.sort(row.researched); table.insert(report.forces, row)
          end
          for _, player in pairs(game.players) do table.insert(report.players, {name=player.name, force=player.force.name, surface=player.surface and player.surface.name or nil, position=player.position}) end
          for _, surface in pairs(game.surfaces) do
            local row = {name=surface.name, index=surface.index, chunks=0, player_entities=0, entities={}, rocket_science_machines=0}
            for _ in surface.get_chunks() do row.chunks = row.chunks + 1 end
            for force_name, _ in pairs(real_forces) do
              local ok, count = pcall(function() return surface.count_entities_filtered{force=force_name} end)
              if ok then row.player_entities = row.player_entities + count end
            end
            for _, entity_name in pairs({"se-rocket-launch-pad", "se-rocket-landing-pad", "se-space-science-lab", "se-space-assembling-machine", "se-space-manufactory", "rocket-silo"}) do
              local ok, count = pcall(function() return surface.count_entities_filtered{name=entity_name} end)
              row.entities[entity_name] = ok and count or -1
            end
            for _, entity in pairs(surface.find_entities_filtered{type={"assembling-machine", "furnace", "rocket-silo"}}) do
              local ok, recipe = pcall(function() return entity.get_recipe() end)
              if ok and recipe then
                report.recipes[recipe.name] = (report.recipes[recipe.name] or 0) + 1
                if recipe.name == "se-rocket-science-pack" then
                  report.rocket_science_machines = report.rocket_science_machines + 1
                  row.rocket_science_machines = row.rocket_science_machines + 1
                  local status_ok, status = pcall(function() return entity.status end)
                  if status_ok and status == defines.entity_status.working then report.rocket_science_working = report.rocket_science_working + 1 end
                end
                if string.find(recipe.name, "rocket", 1, true) or string.find(recipe.name, "satellite", 1, true) then report.rocket_science_support[recipe.name] = (report.rocket_science_support[recipe.name] or 0) + 1 end
              end
            end
            table.insert(report.surfaces, row)
          end
          rcon.print(game.table_to_json(report))
          '''

          with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', 27500), timeout=30) as sock:
              sock.settimeout(180)
              sock.sendall(packet(1, 3, 'inspect')); auth = receive(sock)
              if auth[0] == -1: raise RuntimeError('RCON authentication failed')
              sock.sendall(packet(2, 2, '/sc ' + lua)); body = receive(sock)[2].strip()
          pathlib.Path('published/rcon-raw.txt').write_text(body)

          import json, re, subprocess, pathlib, time

          queries = [
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 save game",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 pre space",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough",
          ]
          exact_ids = ["dDyBD4oE5Qg"]
          candidates = {}

          def run(args, timeout=180):
              return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)

          for q in queries:
              result = run(["yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-json", f"ytsearch40:{q}"], timeout=240)
              pathlib.Path("published/search-stderr.txt").open("a").write(result.stderr)
              for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
                  try:
                      obj = json.loads(line)
                  except Exception:
                      continue
                  vid = obj.get("id")
                  if not vid:
                      continue
                  title = obj.get("title") or ""
                  candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": title, "queries": []})["queries"].append(q)

          for vid in exact_ids:
              candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": "", "queries": ["exact known lead"]})

          # Prioritize titles that are plausibly around the target checkpoint.
          target_words = (
              "rocket", "space", "orbit", "science", "cargo", "launch", "preparation",
              "first space", "nauvis", "automation", "automating"
          )
          ordered = sorted(
              candidates.values(),
              key=lambda x: (0 if any(w in x["title"].lower() for w in target_words) else 1, x["title"].lower())
          )[:120]

          url_re = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"']+")
          file_host_re = re.compile(
              r"(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|onedrive\.live\.com|1drv\.ms|mega\.nz|"
              r"mediafire\.com|github\.com|gitlab\.com|patreon\.com|ko-fi\.com|factorio\.com|refactorio\.de|"
              r"\.zip(?:[?&#]|$))",
              re.I,
          )
          results = []

          for index, item in enumerate(ordered):
              vid = item["id"]
              url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}"
              proc = run([
                  "yt-dlp", "--skip-download", "--no-warnings", "--dump-single-json", url
              ], timeout=180)
              rec = dict(item)
              rec["url"] = url
              rec["metadata_error"] = proc.stderr[-2000:] if proc.returncode else ""
              if proc.returncode == 0:
                  try:
                      meta = json.loads(proc.stdout)
                  except Exception as exc:
                      rec["metadata_error"] = repr(exc)
                  else:
                      desc = meta.get("description") or ""
                      rec.update({
                          "title": meta.get("title") or rec["title"],
                          "channel": meta.get("channel") or meta.get("uploader"),
                          "upload_date": meta.get("upload_date"),
                          "duration": meta.get("duration"),
                          "description": desc,
                          "external_urls": url_re.findall(desc),
                      })
                      rec["potential_save_links"] = [u.rstrip(".,;:!?") for u in rec["external_urls"] if file_host_re.search(u)]
              results.append(rec)
              if index % 20 == 19:
                  time.sleep(2)

          pathlib.Path("published/youtube-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
          links = []
          for r in results:
              for link in r.get("potential_save_links", []):
                  links.append({

                      "title": r.get("title"),
                      "channel": r.get("channel"),
                      "upload_date": r.get("upload_date"),
                      "video_url": r.get("url"),

                  })

name: Temporary SE Speedrun.com save search

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: "tmp-se-speedrun-result-20260824"

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Search Speedrun.com API and linked run evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published/downloads

          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, time, urllib.error, urllib.parse, urllib.request

          OUT = pathlib.Path('published')
          UA = {'User-Agent': 'JJ-SE-save-search/1.0 (public speedrun data research)'}
          errors = []

          def get_json(url: str, attempts: int = 6):
              for attempt in range(attempts):
                  try:
                      req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as response:
                          return json.load(response)
                  except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                      if exc.code in (420, 429, 502, 503, 504) and attempt + 1 < attempts:
                          time.sleep(3 * (attempt + 1)); continue
                      raise
                  except Exception:
                      if attempt + 1 < attempts:
                          time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1)); continue
                      raise

          API = 'https://www.speedrun.com/api/v1'
          game_queries = ['Factorio', 'Factorio Category Extensions', 'Space Exploration']
          games = {}
          for name in game_queries:
              url = API + '/games?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'name': name, 'max': 200})
              try:
                  for game in get_json(url).get('data', []):
                      international = (game.get('names') or {}).get('international', '')
                      if 'factorio' in international.lower() or international.lower() == 'space exploration':
                          games[game['id']] = game
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'game-search', 'name': name, 'error': repr(exc)})

          # Pull derived/category-extension games from every Factorio match.
          for game in list(games.values()):
              try:
                  data = get_json(API + f"/games/{game['id']}/derived-games").get('data', [])
                  for derived in data:
                      games[derived['id']] = derived
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'derived-games', 'game': game['id'], 'error': repr(exc)})

          categories = {}
          variables = {}
          matching_category_ids = set()
          matching_value_filters = []
          text_hits = []

          def contains_se(text: str) -> bool:
              low = (text or '').lower()
              return ('space exploration' in low or 'space-exploration' in low or
                      re.search(r'(^|[^a-z0-9])se\s*0?[67]([^a-z0-9]|$)', low) is not None)

          for game in games.values():
              gid = game['id']
              try:
                  cats = get_json(API + f'/games/{gid}/categories?max=200').get('data', [])
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'categories', 'game': gid, 'error': repr(exc)})
                  continue
              for cat in cats:
                  cat['_game'] = gid
                  categories[cat['id']] = cat
                  combined = ' '.join([cat.get('name') or '', cat.get('rules') or '', cat.get('weblink') or ''])
                  if contains_se(combined):
                      matching_category_ids.add(cat['id'])
                      text_hits.append({'type': 'category', 'game': gid, 'category': cat})
              try:
                  vars_ = get_json(API + f'/games/{gid}/variables?max=200').get('data', [])
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage': 'variables', 'game': gid, 'error': repr(exc)})
                  vars_ = []
              for var in vars_:
                  var['_game'] = gid
                  variables[var['id']] = var
                  if contains_se((var.get('name') or '') + ' ' + (var.get('description') or '')):
                      text_hits.append({'type': 'variable', 'game': gid, 'variable': var})
                  values = ((var.get('values') or {}).get('values') or {})
                  for value_id, value in values.items():
                      label = value.get('label') or ''
                      rules = value.get('rules') or ''
                      if contains_se(label + ' ' + rules):
                          matching_value_filters.append({'game': gid, 'variable': var['id'], 'value': value_id, 'label': label, 'rules': rules, 'category': var.get('category')})
                          text_hits.append({'type': 'value', 'game': gid, 'variable_id': var['id'], 'value_id': value_id, 'label': label, 'rules': rules})
                          if var.get('category'):
                              matching_category_ids.add(var['category'])

          # Fetch every run for Factorio-family games. There are only a few thousand.
          all_runs = []
          for game in games.values():
              gid = game['id']
              offset = 0
              while True:
                  url = API + '/runs?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'game': gid, 'max': 200, 'offset': offset, 'orderby': 'submitted', 'direction': 'desc'})
                  try:
                      page = get_json(url).get('data', [])
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage': 'runs', 'game': gid, 'offset': offset, 'error': repr(exc)})
                      break
                  all_runs.extend(page)
                  if len(page) < 200: break
                  offset += len(page)
                  time.sleep(0.7)

          url_re = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"\']+')
          file_re = re.compile(r'(?:\.zip(?:[?&#]|$)|\.7z(?:[?&#]|$)|\.rar(?:[?&#]|$)|\.sav(?:[?&#]|$)|drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|github\.com/.*/(?:releases|raw|blob)|archive\.org)', re.I)
          evidence_words = re.compile(r'\b(save|savegame|save file|replay|factorio zip|map download)\b', re.I)

          candidates = []
          for run in all_runs:
              cat_id = run.get('category')
              values = run.get('values') or {}
              exact_se_value = any(values.get(f['variable']) == f['value'] for f in matching_value_filters)
              comment = run.get('comment') or ''
              videos = ((run.get('videos') or {}).get('links') or [])
              video_uris = [v.get('uri') for v in videos if v.get('uri')]
              urls = [u.rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(comment)]
              linked_files = [u for u in urls if file_re.search(u)]
              likely_se = cat_id in matching_category_ids or exact_se_value or contains_se(comment)
              evidence = bool(linked_files or evidence_words.search(comment))
              if likely_se or evidence:
                  candidates.append({
                      'id': run.get('id'), 'weblink': run.get('weblink'), 'game': run.get('game'),
                      'category': cat_id, 'date': run.get('date'), 'submitted': run.get('submitted'),
                      'status': run.get('status'), 'times': run.get('times'), 'players': run.get('players'),
                      'values': values, 'comment': comment, 'video_uris': video_uris,
                      'urls': urls, 'linked_files': linked_files, 'likely_space_exploration': likely_se,
                      'matched_category': cat_id in matching_category_ids, 'matched_value': exact_se_value,
                  })

          # Try to fetch HTML run pages for likely SE runs because file links may be rendered outside API comments.
          for rec in candidates:
              if not rec['likely_space_exploration'] or not rec.get('weblink'): continue
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(rec['weblink'], headers=UA)
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40) as response:
                      html = response.read(4_000_000).decode('utf-8', 'replace')
                  html_urls = [u.replace('\\u0026', '&').replace('&amp;', '&').rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(html)]
                  rec['html_file_links'] = [u for u in html_urls if file_re.search(u)]
              except Exception as exc:
                  rec['html_error'] = repr(exc)

          # Attempt actual downloads of public file-host links where a direct URL is already exposed.
          downloads = []
          dedup_links = []
          seen = set()
          for rec in candidates:
              if not rec['likely_space_exploration']: continue
              for u in rec.get('linked_files', []) + rec.get('html_file_links', []):
                  if u not in seen:
                      seen.add(u); dedup_links.append((rec, u))
          for index, (rec, u) in enumerate(dedup_links[:50]):
              direct = u
              if 'drive.google.com/file/d/' in u:
                  m = re.search(r'/file/d/([^/]+)', u)
                  if m: direct = 'https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=' + m.group(1) + '&export=download&confirm=t'
              elif 'dropbox.com/' in u:
                  direct = re.sub(r'[?&]dl=0', '', u)
                  direct += ('&' if '?' in direct else '?') + 'dl=1'
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(direct, headers=UA)
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as response:
                      data = response.read(200_000_001)
                      ctype = response.headers.get('Content-Type')
                  if len(data) > 200_000_000: raise RuntimeError('file over 200 MB limit')
                  name = f"{index:02d}_{rec['id']}.bin"
                  pathlib.Path('published/downloads', name).write_bytes(data)
                  downloads.append({'run': rec['id'], 'source': u, 'direct': direct, 'bytes': len(data), 'content_type': ctype, 'file': 'downloads/' + name, 'magic': data[:32].hex()})
              except Exception as exc:
                  downloads.append({'run': rec['id'], 'source': u, 'direct': direct, 'error': repr(exc)})

          summary = {
              'games': len(games), 'categories': len(categories), 'variables': len(variables),
              'matching_categories': len(matching_category_ids), 'matching_values': len(matching_value_filters),
              'all_runs': len(all_runs), 'candidate_runs': len(candidates),
              'likely_se_runs': sum(1 for r in candidates if r['likely_space_exploration']),
              'public_file_links': len(dedup_links), 'downloads_attempted': len(downloads),
          }
          OUT.joinpath('games.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(games.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('categories.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(categories.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('variables.json').write_text(json.dumps(list(variables.values()), indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('matching-text.json').write_text(json.dumps(text_hits, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('candidate-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(candidates, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('downloads.json').write_text(json.dumps(downloads, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
          OUT.joinpath('summary.txt').write_text('\n'.join(f'{k}: {v}' for k,v in summary.items()))
          print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
          PY

          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

jobs:

    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:

        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          import json, re, time, urllib.parse, urllib.request, urllib.error, pathlib, ssl

          ssl._create_default_https_context = ssl._create_unverified_context
          ua = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 SE-save-search/1.0'}
          def get_json(url, timeout=25, data=None, headers=None):
              h = dict(ua)
              if headers: h.update(headers)
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=h)
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                  return json.load(r)

          url_re = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>\]\[()\"\']+')
          host_re = re.compile(r'(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|1drv\.ms|onedrive\.live\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|github\.com|gitlab\.com|patreon\.com|ko-fi\.com|refactorio\.de|\.zip(?:[?&#]|$))', re.I)
          queries = [
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science',
              'Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 save game',
              'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
          ]
          exact_ids = {'dDyBD4oE5Qg'}
          errors=[]; instances=[]; videos={}; inspected=[]; links=[]

          # Discover Invidious instances with API enabled.
          try:
              raw = get_json('https://api.invidious.io/instances.json', timeout=30)
              for host, meta in raw:
                  details = meta.get('details') or {}
                  if meta.get('type') == 'https' and details.get('api') and details.get('monitor', {}).get('dailyRatios'):
                      instances.append('https://' + host)
                  elif meta.get('type') == 'https' and details.get('api'):
                      instances.append('https://' + host)
          except Exception as exc:
              errors.append({'stage':'instances','error':repr(exc)})

          # Add known public instances, availability varies by the minute because naturally it does.
          instances += [
              'https://inv.nadeko.net','https://yewtu.be','https://invidious.nerdvpn.de',
              'https://inv.us.projectsegfau.lt','https://invidious.private.coffee',
              'https://invidious.privacyredirect.com','https://iv.ggtyler.dev'
          ]
          seen=set(); instances=[x for x in instances if not (x in seen or seen.add(x))]

          working=[]
          for base in instances[:50]:
              try:
                  data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/stats', timeout=12)
                  if isinstance(data, dict): working.append(base)
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage':'probe','base':base,'error':repr(exc)})
              if len(working) >= 8: break

          for q in queries:
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/search?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'q':q,'type':'video','sort_by':'relevance'}), timeout=20)
                      for item in data[:30]:
                          vid=item.get('videoId')
                          if vid:
                              videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':item.get('title'),'author':item.get('author'),'queries':[]})['queries'].append(q)
                      break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'search','base':base,'query':q,'error':repr(exc)})
          for vid in exact_ids: videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':'','author':'','queries':['exact lead']})

          target_words=('rocket','space','orbit','science','cargo','launch','automation','automating','nauvis')
          ordered=sorted(videos.values(), key=lambda x:(0 if any(w in (x.get('title') or '').lower() for w in target_words) else 1,(x.get('title') or '').lower()))[:180]

          # YouTube Innertube fallback. The WEB client often returns shortDescription without login.
          def youtube_innertube(vid):
              body=json.dumps({'context':{'client':{'clientName':'WEB','clientVersion':'2.20260820.00.00','hl':'en'}},'videoId':vid}).encode()
              return get_json('https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false', timeout=25, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Origin':'https://www.youtube.com'})

          for idx,item in enumerate(ordered):
              vid=item['videoId']; meta=None; source=None
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      meta=get_json(base + '/api/v1/videos/' + vid, timeout=20); source=base; break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'video','base':base,'id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              if meta is None:
                  try:
                      raw=youtube_innertube(vid)
                      vd=raw.get('videoDetails') or {}
                      if vd:
                          meta={'videoId':vid,'title':vd.get('title'),'author':vd.get('author'),'description':vd.get('shortDescription'),'lengthSeconds':vd.get('lengthSeconds')}
                          source='youtube-innertube'
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'innertube','id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              rec=dict(item); rec['source']=source
              if meta:
                  desc=meta.get('description') or meta.get('shortDescription') or ''
                  rec.update({'title':meta.get('title') or rec.get('title'),'author':meta.get('author') or meta.get('authorId') or rec.get('author'),'description':desc,'published':meta.get('publishedText') or meta.get('published'),'lengthSeconds':meta.get('lengthSeconds')})
                  urls=[u.rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(desc)]
                  rec['urls']=urls; rec['potential_save_links']=[u for u in urls if host_re.search(u)]
                  for u in rec['potential_save_links']:
                      links.append({'videoId':vid,'title':rec.get('title'),'author':rec.get('author'),'url':'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='+vid,'link':u})
              inspected.append(rec)
              if idx%25==24: time.sleep(1)

          pathlib.Path('published/working-instances.json').write_text(json.dumps(working,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(inspected,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(links,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(f"{x['title']} | {x['author']}\n{x['url']}\n{x['link']}" for x in links))
          pathlib.Path('published/exact-bold-viking.json').write_text(json.dumps([x for x in inspected if x['videoId']=='dDyBD4oE5Qg'],indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2))
          summary={'instances_discovered':len(instances),'instances_working':len(working),'videos_found':len(videos),'videos_inspected':len(inspected),'save_links':len(links)}
          pathlib.Path('published/summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

          from __future__ import annotations
          import hashlib, io, json, pathlib, struct, subprocess, zipfile

          P=pathlib.Path
          candidates=json.loads(P('work/candidates.json').read_text())
          results=[]

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self,data): self.data=data; self.offset=0
              def u8(self): v=self.data[self.offset]; self.offset+=1; return v
              def u16(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<H',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=2; return v
              def u32(self): v=struct.unpack_from('<I',self.data,self.offset)[0]; self.offset+=4; return v
              def version(self): return (self.u16(),self.u16(),self.u16(),self.u16())
              def opt(self,bits,fv):
                  if fv>(0,14,14,0):
                      first=self.u8()
                      if first!=0xff:return first
                  return self.u16() if bits==16 else self.u32()
              def text(self,fv):
                  n=self.opt(32,fv); raw=self.data[self.offset:self.offset+n]; self.offset+=n
                  return raw.decode('utf-8','replace')
              def version48(self,fv): return (self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv),self.opt(16,fv))
          def parse_header(data):
              r=Reader(data);fv=r.version();r.u8()
              out={'factorio_version_full':'.'.join(map(str,fv)),'factorio_version':'.'.join(map(str,fv[:3])),'save_name':r.text(fv),'campaign':r.text(fv),'base_mod':r.text(fv)}
              out['difficulty']=r.u8();out['finished']=bool(r.u8());out['player_won']=bool(r.u8());out['next_level']=r.text(fv)

          def inspect_zip_bytes(data:bytes, trail:list[str], depth:int=0):
              if depth>3:return None
              try:z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
              except Exception:return None
              with z:
                  names=z.namelist()

                  level=next((n for n in names if n.endswith('/level.dat') or n=='level.dat'),None)
                  if init and level:
                      return {'data':data,'zip':z,'names':names,'init':init,'trail':trail}
                  nested=[]
                  for info in z.infolist():
                      if info.is_dir() or not info.filename.lower().endswith(('.zip','.sav')):continue
                      if info.file_size<100000 or info.file_size>700000000:continue
                      nested.append(info)
                  nested.sort(key=lambda x:(0 if any(w in x.filename.lower() for w in ('save','space','se','rocket','autosave')) else 1,x.file_size))
                  for info in nested:
                      try:child=z.read(info)
                      except Exception:continue

                      if found:return found
              return None

          lua=r'''

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')
              length = struct.unpack('<i', header)[0]; data = b''
              while len(data) < length:
                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))
                  if not chunk: raise RuntimeError('RCON connection closed')
                  data += chunk
              request_id, packet_type = struct.unpack_from('<ii', data, 0)
              return request_id, packet_type, data[8:-2].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

            for name, tech in pairs(force.technologies) do
              if tech.researched and (string.find(name, "rocket", 1, true) or string.find(name, "space", 1, true)) then table.insert(row.researched, name) end
            end
            table.sort(row.researched); table.insert(report.forces, row)
          end
          for _, player in pairs(game.players) do table.insert(report.players, {name=player.name, force=player.force.name, surface=player.surface and player.surface.name or nil, position=player.position}) end
          for _, surface in pairs(game.surfaces) do
            local row = {name=surface.name, index=surface.index, chunks=0, player_entities=0, entities={}, rocket_science_machines=0}
            for _ in surface.get_chunks() do row.chunks = row.chunks + 1 end
            for force_name, _ in pairs(real_forces) do
              local ok, count = pcall(function() return surface.count_entities_filtered{force=force_name} end)
              if ok then row.player_entities = row.player_entities + count end

          def api(url: str):
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=api_headers)
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as r:
                  return json.load(r)

          queries = [
              'factorio save pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio saves pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio-save pushed:>=2025-09-22',
              'factorio_saves pushed:>=2025-09-22',

                  url = 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({
                      'q': q, 'per_page': 100, 'page': page, 'sort': 'updated', 'order': 'desc'
                  })

                      data = api(url)
                  except Exception as exc:
                      search_errors.append({'query': q, 'page': page, 'error': repr(exc)})

                          'description': item.get('description'),

          ]:

                  try:

          class Reader:
              def __init__(self, data: bytes): self.data, self.offset = data, 0
              def u8(self):

              def u16(self):

                  v = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.data, self.offset)[0]; self.offset += 4; return v
              def version(self): return (self.u16(), self.u16(), self.u16(), self.u16())

                  if fv > (0, 14, 14, 0):

                      if first != 0xff: return first
                  return self.u16() if bits == 16 else self.u32()

                  return raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace')

                              'space_scaffold': b'se-space-platform-scaffold',
                          }.items(): marker_counts[label] = script.count(marker)

                          **item, 'raw_url': raw_url, 'downloaded_bytes': len(data),

                          'se_version': mods.get('space-exploration'),

          import json, pathlib, socket, struct

          def packet(request_id, packet_type, body):
              payload = struct.pack('<ii', request_id, packet_type) + body.encode() + b'\0\0'
              return struct.pack('<i', len(payload)) + payload
          def receive(sock):
              header = sock.recv(4)
              if len(header) != 4: raise RuntimeError('short RCON header')

                  chunk = sock.recv(length - len(data))

                  data += chunk

              "Factorio SE 0.7 pre space",

          def run(args, timeout=180):
              return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)

          for q in queries:
              result = run(["yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-json", f"ytsearch40:{q}"], timeout=240)
              pathlib.Path("published/search-stderr.txt").open("a").write(result.stderr)
              for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
                  try:
                      obj = json.loads(line)
                  except Exception:
                      continue
                  vid = obj.get("id")
                  if not vid:
                      continue
                  title = obj.get("title") or ""
                  candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": title, "queries": []})["queries"].append(q)

              candidates.setdefault(vid, {"id": vid, "title": "", "queries": ["exact known lead"]})

          # Prioritize titles that are plausibly around the target checkpoint.

              "rocket", "space", "orbit", "science", "cargo", "launch", "preparation",
              "first space", "nauvis", "automation", "automating"
          )

              candidates.values(),

          )[:120]

name: Temporary SE Speedrun.com save search

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: "tmp-se-speedrun-result-20260824"

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
