                      instances.append('https://' + host)
          except Exception as exc:
              errors.append({'stage':'instances','error':repr(exc)})

          # Add known public instances, availability varies by the minute because naturally it does.
          instances += [
              'https://inv.nadeko.net','https://yewtu.be','https://invidious.nerdvpn.de',
              'https://inv.us.projectsegfau.lt','https://invidious.private.coffee',
              'https://invidious.privacyredirect.com','https://iv.ggtyler.dev'
          ]
          seen=set(); instances=[x for x in instances if not (x in seen or seen.add(x))]

          working=[]
          for base in instances[:50]:
              try:
                  data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/stats', timeout=12)
                  if isinstance(data, dict): working.append(base)
              except Exception as exc:
                  errors.append({'stage':'probe','base':base,'error':repr(exc)})
              if len(working) >= 8: break

          for q in queries:
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      data = get_json(base + '/api/v1/search?' + urllib.parse.urlencode({'q':q,'type':'video','sort_by':'relevance'}), timeout=20)
                      for item in data[:30]:
                          vid=item.get('videoId')
                          if vid:
                              videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':item.get('title'),'author':item.get('author'),'queries':[]})['queries'].append(q)
                      break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'search','base':base,'query':q,'error':repr(exc)})
          for vid in exact_ids: videos.setdefault(vid, {'videoId':vid,'title':'','author':'','queries':['exact lead']})

          target_words=('rocket','space','orbit','science','cargo','launch','automation','automating','nauvis')
          ordered=sorted(videos.values(), key=lambda x:(0 if any(w in (x.get('title') or '').lower() for w in target_words) else 1,(x.get('title') or '').lower()))[:180]

          # YouTube Innertube fallback. The WEB client often returns shortDescription without login.
          def youtube_innertube(vid):
              body=json.dumps({'context':{'client':{'clientName':'WEB','clientVersion':'2.20260820.00.00','hl':'en'}},'videoId':vid}).encode()
              return get_json('https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false', timeout=25, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Origin':'https://www.youtube.com'})

          for idx,item in enumerate(ordered):
              vid=item['videoId']; meta=None; source=None
              for base in working:
                  try:
                      meta=get_json(base + '/api/v1/videos/' + vid, timeout=20); source=base; break
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'video','base':base,'id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              if meta is None:
                  try:
                      raw=youtube_innertube(vid)
                      vd=raw.get('videoDetails') or {}
                      if vd:
                          meta={'videoId':vid,'title':vd.get('title'),'author':vd.get('author'),'description':vd.get('shortDescription'),'lengthSeconds':vd.get('lengthSeconds')}
                          source='youtube-innertube'
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append({'stage':'innertube','id':vid,'error':repr(exc)})
              rec=dict(item); rec['source']=source
              if meta:
                  desc=meta.get('description') or meta.get('shortDescription') or ''
                  rec.update({'title':meta.get('title') or rec.get('title'),'author':meta.get('author') or meta.get('authorId') or rec.get('author'),'description':desc,'published':meta.get('publishedText') or meta.get('published'),'lengthSeconds':meta.get('lengthSeconds')})
                  urls=[u.rstrip('.,;:!?') for u in url_re.findall(desc)]
                  rec['urls']=urls; rec['potential_save_links']=[u for u in urls if host_re.search(u)]
                  for u in rec['potential_save_links']:
                      links.append({'videoId':vid,'title':rec.get('title'),'author':rec.get('author'),'url':'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='+vid,'link':u})
              inspected.append(rec)
              if idx%25==24: time.sleep(1)

          pathlib.Path('published/working-instances.json').write_text(json.dumps(working,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(inspected,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(links,indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/save-links.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(f"{x['title']} | {x['author']}\n{x['url']}\n{x['link']}" for x in links))
          pathlib.Path('published/exact-bold-viking.json').write_text(json.dumps([x for x in inspected if x['videoId']=='dDyBD4oE5Qg'],indent=2))
          pathlib.Path('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2))
          summary={'instances_discovered':len(instances),'instances_working':len(working),'videos_found':len(videos),'videos_inspected':len(inspected),'save_links':len(links)}
          pathlib.Path('published/summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish findings
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-video-api-search
          mkdir -p tmp-se-video-api-search
          cp -a published/. tmp-se-video-api-search/
          git add -f tmp-se-video-api-search
          git commit -m 'Search public video APIs for SE save links'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"

name: Alternate YouTube hunt for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [tmp-se-youtube-alt-20260824]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  hunt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 110
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and recover descriptions through alternate endpoints
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf se-youtube-alt-work se-youtube-alt-result
          mkdir -p se-youtube-alt-work se-youtube-alt-result
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp requests
          cat > se-youtube-alt-work/hunt.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations

          import concurrent.futures
          import html
          import json
          import pathlib
          import re
          import subprocess
          import time
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          import requests

          OUT = pathlib.Path("se-youtube-alt-result")
          OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          SESSION = requests.Session()
          SESSION.headers.update({
              "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/126 Safari/537.36",
              "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
          })

          QUERIES = [
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 Nauvis orbit",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 satellite",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 launch pad",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 2025 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 2026 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration save download",
              "Factorio SE save game download",
          ]

          URL_RX = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\"'\\]+", re.I)
          SAVE_HOSTS = (
              "drive.google.com", "docs.google.com", "dropbox.com", "mediafire.com",
              "mega.nz", "mega.io", "onedrive.live.com", "1drv.ms", "github.com",
              "gitlab.com", "factorio.com", "patreon.com", "ko-fi.com", "gumroad.com",
              "itch.io", "bit.ly", "tinyurl.com", "linktr.ee", "beacons.ai",
          )
          TARGET_TERMS = re.compile(
              r"(?i)(save\s*(?:game|file|download)|download\s*(?:the\s*)?save|"
              r"rocket\s+science|cargo\s+rocket|launch\s+pad|satellite|nauvis\s+orbit|"
              r"space\s+exploration\s+0\.7|\bse\s*0\.7)"
          )

          def run_flat_search(query: str) -> list[dict]:
              cmd = [
                  "yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-single-json", "--no-warnings",
                  f"ytsearch100:{query}",
              ]
              proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
              if proc.returncode:
                  return [{"_error": proc.stderr[-4000:], "_query": query}]
              data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
              result = []
              for entry in data.get("entries") or []:
                  if not entry or not entry.get("id"):
                      continue
                  result.append({
                      "id": entry.get("id"),
                      "title": entry.get("title"),
                      "url": entry.get("url") or f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={entry['id']}",
                      "channel": entry.get("channel") or entry.get("uploader"),
                      "channel_id": entry.get("channel_id") or entry.get("uploader_id"),
                      "timestamp": entry.get("timestamp"),
                      "duration": entry.get("duration"),
                      "playlist": entry.get("playlist"),
                      "playlist_id": entry.get("playlist_id"),
                      "query": query,
                  })
              return result

          def json_string_value(raw: str) -> str:
              try:
                  return json.loads('"' + raw + '"')
              except Exception:
                  return html.unescape(raw.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\/", "/"))

          def extract_description(text: str) -> str | None:
              patterns = [
                  r'"shortDescription"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
                  r'"description"\s*:\s*\{\s*"simpleText"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
                  r'"description"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
              ]
              for pat in patterns:
                  match = re.search(pat, text, re.S)
                  if match:
                      value = json_string_value(match.group(1)).strip()
                      if value:
                          return value
              return None

          def get_text(url: str, timeout: int = 18) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
              try:
                  response = SESSION.get(url, timeout=timeout)
                  if response.status_code == 200 and response.text:
                      return response.text, None
                  return None, f"HTTP {response.status_code}"
              except Exception as exc:
                  return None, repr(exc)

          def load_instances() -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
              inv: list[str] = []
              piped: list[str] = []
              try:
                  data = SESSION.get("https://api.invidious.io/instances.json?sort_by=health", timeout=20).json()
                  for host, meta in data:
                      if isinstance(meta, dict) and meta.get("api") and meta.get("type") == "https":
                          inv.append("https://" + host.rstrip("/"))
              except Exception:
                  pass
              try:
                  data = SESSION.get("https://piped.video/api/v1/instances", timeout=20).json()
                  for item in data:
                      api = item.get("api_url") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
                      if api:
                          piped.append(api.rstrip("/"))
              except Exception:
                  pass
              # Frequently available historical endpoints, tried only after dynamic lists.
              inv.extend([
                  "https://yewtu.be", "https://inv.nadeko.net", "https://invidious.nerdvpn.de",
                  "https://invidious.privacyredirect.com",
              ])
              piped.extend([
                  "https://pipedapi.kavin.rocks", "https://pipedapi.adminforge.de",
                  "https://pipedapi.reallyaweso.me",
              ])
              return list(dict.fromkeys(inv))[:12], list(dict.fromkeys(piped))[:12]

          INVIDIOUS, PIPED = load_instances()

          def description_from_apis(video_id: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
              errors = []
              for base in INVIDIOUS[:6]:
                  try:
                      r = SESSION.get(f"{base}/api/v1/videos/{video_id}", timeout=12)
                      if r.status_code == 200:
                          d = r.json()
                          desc = d.get("description") or d.get("descriptionHtml")
                          if desc:
                              return html.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", desc)), f"invidious:{base}"
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{r.status_code}")
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{type(exc).__name__}")
              for base in PIPED[:6]:
                  try:
                      r = SESSION.get(f"{base}/streams/{video_id}", timeout=12)
                      if r.status_code == 200:
                          d = r.json()
                          desc = d.get("description")
                          if desc:
                              return desc, f"piped:{base}"
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{r.status_code}")
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{type(exc).__name__}")
              return None, "; ".join(errors[-8:])

          def recover_one(base: dict) -> dict:
              video_id = base["id"]
              rec = dict(base)
              rec["video_url"] = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}"
              rec["description"] = None
              rec["description_source"] = None
              rec["errors"] = []

              endpoints = [
                  f"https://www.youtube.com/embed/{video_id}?hl=en",
                  f"https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/{video_id}?hl=en",
                  f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}&hl=en&gl=US&persist_hl=1",
              ]
              for endpoint in endpoints:
                  text, err = get_text(endpoint)
                  if text:
                      desc = extract_description(text)
                      if desc:
                          rec["description"] = desc
                          rec["description_source"] = endpoint.split('/')[2]
                          break
                  if err:
                      rec["errors"].append(endpoint.split('/')[2] + ":" + err)

              if not rec["description"]:
                  desc, source = description_from_apis(video_id)
                  if desc:
                      rec["description"] = desc
                      rec["description_source"] = source
                  elif source:
                      rec["errors"].append(source)

              if not rec["description"]:
                  text, err = get_text(f"https://r.jina.ai/http://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}", timeout=30)
                  if text and len(text) > 80:
                      rec["jina_text"] = text[:30000]
                      # Jina often labels the description, but even when it does not, preserving the
                      # page text lets the link extractor recover description URLs.
                      rec["description"] = text
                      rec["description_source"] = "r.jina.ai"
                  elif err:
                      rec["errors"].append("jina:" + err)

              desc = rec.get("description") or ""
              urls = []
              for raw in URL_RX.findall(desc):
                  clean = html.unescape(raw).rstrip(".,;:!?)\]}>'\"")
                  if clean and clean not in urls:
                      urls.append(clean)
              rec["links"] = urls
              return rec

          def resolve_link(url: str) -> dict:
              result = {"url": url, "final_url": url, "status": None, "error": None}
              try:
                  # Stream only a tiny prefix. This follows shorteners without downloading save files.
                  with SESSION.get(url, timeout=18, allow_redirects=True, stream=True) as r:
                      result["status"] = r.status_code
                      result["final_url"] = r.url
              except Exception as exc:
                  result["error"] = repr(exc)
              return result

          # Search in parallel so one slow query does not consume the whole run.
          search_rows: list[dict] = []
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
              futures = {pool.submit(run_flat_search, q): q for q in QUERIES}
              for fut in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
                  search_rows.extend(fut.result())

          errors = [r for r in search_rows if r.get("_error")]
          by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
          for row in search_rows:
              if row.get("_error"):
                  continue
              vid = row["id"]
              if vid not in by_id:
                  by_id[vid] = row
                  by_id[vid]["queries"] = [row["query"]]
              elif row["query"] not in by_id[vid]["queries"]:
                  by_id[vid]["queries"].append(row["query"])

          # Titles that mention the target stage go first; all unique results are still attempted.
          ordered = sorted(
              by_id.values(),
              key=lambda r: (
                  0 if TARGET_TERMS.search((r.get("title") or "")) else 1,
                  r.get("title") or "",
              ),
          )
          print(f"Flat-search rows={len(search_rows)} unique={len(ordered)}")
          print(f"Instances: invidious={len(INVIDIOUS)} piped={len(PIPED)}")

          recovered: list[dict] = []
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=14) as pool:
              futures = [pool.submit(recover_one, row) for row in ordered]
              for index, fut in enumerate(concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures), 1):
                  recovered.append(fut.result())
                  if index % 50 == 0:
                      got = sum(bool(r.get("description")) for r in recovered)
                      print(f"Recovered {index}/{len(ordered)} descriptions={got}")

          link_rows = []
          candidate_links = []
          for rec in recovered:
              for url in rec.get("links") or []:
                  row = {
                      "video_id": rec["id"],
                      "title": rec.get("title"),
                      "channel": rec.get("channel"),
                      "video_url": rec.get("video_url"),
                      "url": url,
                  }
                  link_rows.append(row)
                  low = url.lower()
                  host = urlparse(url).netloc.lower()
                  if host in SAVE_HOSTS or any(h in host for h in SAVE_HOSTS) or ".zip" in low:
                      candidate_links.append(row)

          # Resolve only likely save/link-hub URLs, with deduplication and a conservative cap.
          unique_urls = list(dict.fromkeys(row["url"] for row in candidate_links))[:500]
          resolved_map: dict[str, dict] = {}
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=12) as pool:
              for result in pool.map(resolve_link, unique_urls):
                  resolved_map[result["url"]] = result
          for row in candidate_links:
              row["resolved"] = resolved_map.get(row["url"])

          def score(rec: dict) -> int:
              title = rec.get("title") or ""
              desc = rec.get("description") or ""
              hay = (title + "\n" + desc).lower()
              points = 0
              for term, weight in [
                  ("rocket science", 12), ("cargo rocket", 10), ("launch pad", 7),
                  ("satellite", 5), ("nauvis orbit", 4), ("space exploration 0.7", 6),
                  ("save file", 18), ("save game", 18), ("download save", 20),
                  ("google drive", 18), ("dropbox", 18), ("mediafire", 18),
              ]:
                  if term in hay:
                      points += weight
              if any(row["video_id"] == rec["id"] for row in candidate_links):
                  points += 25
              # Late-space terms do not erase the candidate, but they lower its inspection priority.
              for term in ("cryonite", "vulcanite", "holmium", "iridium", "astronomic science", "energy science", "deep space"):
                  if term in hay:
                      points -= 6
              return points

          for rec in recovered:
              rec["score"] = score(rec)
          ranked = sorted(recovered, key=lambda r: (-r["score"], r.get("title") or ""))

          (OUT / "flat-search.json").write_text(json.dumps(search_rows, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "videos.json").write_text(json.dumps(recovered, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "all-links.json").write_text(json.dumps(link_rows, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "candidate-links.json").write_text(json.dumps(candidate_links, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "ranked.json").write_text(json.dumps(ranked, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "errors.json").write_text(json.dumps(errors, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

          lines = [
              f"Unique videos: {len(ordered)}",
              f"Descriptions recovered: {sum(bool(r.get('description')) for r in recovered)}",
              f"Videos with any extracted URL: {sum(bool(r.get('links')) for r in recovered)}",
              f"Likely save/link-hub URLs: {len(candidate_links)}",
              "",
              "LIKELY SAVE OR LINK-HUB URLS",
              "=" * 80,
          ]
          for row in candidate_links:
              resolved = row.get("resolved") or {}
              lines.extend([
                  f"{row.get('channel')} | {row.get('title')}",
                  row.get("video_url") or "",
                  row.get("url") or "",
                  ("=> " + str(resolved.get("final_url"))) if resolved.get("final_url") and resolved.get("final_url") != row.get("url") else "",
                  "",
              ])
          lines.extend(["", "TOP RANKED VIDEOS", "=" * 80])
          for rec in ranked[:250]:
              lines.extend([
                  f"SCORE {rec['score']} | {rec.get('channel')} | {rec.get('title')}",
                  rec.get("video_url") or "",
                  f"description source: {rec.get('description_source')}",
                  (rec.get("description") or "")[:5000],
                  "",
              ])
          (OUT / "SUMMARY.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
          print("\n".join(lines[:500]))
          PY
          python3 se-youtube-alt-work/hunt.py | tee se-youtube-alt-result/console.txt

      - name: Publish results to a dedicated branch
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com

          git add -f tmp-se-youtube-alt
          git commit -m 'Publish alternate YouTube SE 0.7 hunt results' || true
          git push --force origin HEAD:refs/heads/tmp-se-youtube-alt-result-20260824

          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

BRANCH: tmp-se-youtube-alt-result-20260824
PATH: .github/workflows/tmp-se-youtube-alt.yml
SIZE: 18395 | TARGET_HITS: 44 | STAGE_HITS: 16
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: Alternate YouTube hunt for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [tmp-se-youtube-alt-20260824]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  hunt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 110
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and recover descriptions through alternate endpoints
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf se-youtube-alt-work se-youtube-alt-result
          mkdir -p se-youtube-alt-work se-youtube-alt-result
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp requests
          cat > se-youtube-alt-work/hunt.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations

          import concurrent.futures
          import html
          import json
          import pathlib
          import re
          import subprocess
          import time
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          import requests

          OUT = pathlib.Path("se-youtube-alt-result")
          OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          SESSION = requests.Session()
          SESSION.headers.update({
              "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/126 Safari/537.36",
              "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
          })

          QUERIES = [
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 Nauvis orbit",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 satellite",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 launch pad",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 2025 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 2026 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration save download",
              "Factorio SE save game download",
          ]

          URL_RX = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\"'\\]+", re.I)
          SAVE_HOSTS = (
              "drive.google.com", "docs.google.com", "dropbox.com", "mediafire.com",
              "mega.nz", "mega.io", "onedrive.live.com", "1drv.ms", "github.com",
              "gitlab.com", "factorio.com", "patreon.com", "ko-fi.com", "gumroad.com",
              "itch.io", "bit.ly", "tinyurl.com", "linktr.ee", "beacons.ai",
          )
          TARGET_TERMS = re.compile(
              r"(?i)(save\s*(?:game|file|download)|download\s*(?:the\s*)?save|"
              r"rocket\s+science|cargo\s+rocket|launch\s+pad|satellite|nauvis\s+orbit|"
              r"space\s+exploration\s+0\.7|\bse\s*0\.7)"
          )

          def run_flat_search(query: str) -> list[dict]:
              cmd = [
                  "yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-single-json", "--no-warnings",
                  f"ytsearch100:{query}",
              ]
              proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
              if proc.returncode:
                  return [{"_error": proc.stderr[-4000:], "_query": query}]
              data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
              result = []
              for entry in data.get("entries") or []:
                  if not entry or not entry.get("id"):
                      continue
                  result.append({
                      "id": entry.get("id"),
                      "title": entry.get("title"),
                      "url": entry.get("url") or f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={entry['id']}",
                      "channel": entry.get("channel") or entry.get("uploader"),
                      "channel_id": entry.get("channel_id") or entry.get("uploader_id"),
                      "timestamp": entry.get("timestamp"),
                      "duration": entry.get("duration"),
                      "playlist": entry.get("playlist"),
                      "playlist_id": entry.get("playlist_id"),
                      "query": query,
                  })
              return result

          def json_string_value(raw: str) -> str:
              try:
                  return json.loads('"' + raw + '"')
              except Exception:
                  return html.unescape(raw.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\/", "/"))

          def extract_description(text: str) -> str | None:
              patterns = [
                  r'"shortDescription"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
                  r'"description"\s*:\s*\{\s*"simpleText"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
                  r'"description"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
              ]
              for pat in patterns:
                  match = re.search(pat, text, re.S)
                  if match:
                      value = json_string_value(match.group(1)).strip()
                      if value:
                          return value
              return None

          def get_text(url: str, timeout: int = 18) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
              try:
                  response = SESSION.get(url, timeout=timeout)
                  if response.status_code == 200 and response.text:
                      return response.text, None
                  return None, f"HTTP {response.status_code}"
              except Exception as exc:
                  return None, repr(exc)

          def load_instances() -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
              inv: list[str] = []
              piped: list[str] = []
              try:
                  data = SESSION.get("https://api.invidious.io/instances.json?sort_by=health", timeout=20).json()
                  for host, meta in data:
                      if isinstance(meta, dict) and meta.get("api") and meta.get("type") == "https":
                          inv.append("https://" + host.rstrip("/"))
              except Exception:
                  pass
              try:
                  data = SESSION.get("https://piped.video/api/v1/instances", timeout=20).json()
                  for item in data:
                      api = item.get("api_url") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
                      if api:
                          piped.append(api.rstrip("/"))
              except Exception:
                  pass
              # Frequently available historical endpoints, tried only after dynamic lists.
              inv.extend([
                  "https://yewtu.be", "https://inv.nadeko.net", "https://invidious.nerdvpn.de",
                  "https://invidious.privacyredirect.com",
              ])
              piped.extend([
                  "https://pipedapi.kavin.rocks", "https://pipedapi.adminforge.de",
                  "https://pipedapi.reallyaweso.me",
              ])
              return list(dict.fromkeys(inv))[:12], list(dict.fromkeys(piped))[:12]

          INVIDIOUS, PIPED = load_instances()

          def description_from_apis(video_id: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
              errors = []
              for base in INVIDIOUS[:6]:
                  try:
                      r = SESSION.get(f"{base}/api/v1/videos/{video_id}", timeout=12)
                      if r.status_code == 200:
                          d = r.json()
                          desc = d.get("description") or d.get("descriptionHtml")
                          if desc:
                              return html.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", desc)), f"invidious:{base}"
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{r.status_code}")
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{type(exc).__name__}")
              for base in PIPED[:6]:
                  try:
                      r = SESSION.get(f"{base}/streams/{video_id}", timeout=12)
                      if r.status_code == 200:
                          d = r.json()
                          desc = d.get("description")
                          if desc:
                              return desc, f"piped:{base}"
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{r.status_code}")
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{type(exc).__name__}")
              return None, "; ".join(errors[-8:])

          def recover_one(base: dict) -> dict:
              video_id = base["id"]
              rec = dict(base)
              rec["video_url"] = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}"
              rec["description"] = None
              rec["description_source"] = None
              rec["errors"] = []

              endpoints = [
                  f"https://www.youtube.com/embed/{video_id}?hl=en",
                  f"https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/{video_id}?hl=en",
                  f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}&hl=en&gl=US&persist_hl=1",
              ]
              for endpoint in endpoints:
                  text, err = get_text(endpoint)
                  if text:
                      desc = extract_description(text)
                      if desc:
                          rec["description"] = desc
                          rec["description_source"] = endpoint.split('/')[2]
                          break
                  if err:
                      rec["errors"].append(endpoint.split('/')[2] + ":" + err)

              if not rec["description"]:
                  desc, source = description_from_apis(video_id)
                  if desc:
                      rec["description"] = desc
                      rec["description_source"] = source
                  elif source:
                      rec["errors"].append(source)

              if not rec["description"]:
                  text, err = get_text(f"https://r.jina.ai/http://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}", timeout=30)
                  if text and len(text) > 80:
                      rec["jina_text"] = text[:30000]
                      # Jina often labels the description, but even when it does not, preserving the
                      # page text lets the link extractor recover description URLs.
                      rec["description"] = text
                      rec["description_source"] = "r.jina.ai"
                  elif err:
                      rec["errors"].append("jina:" + err)

              desc = rec.get("description") or ""
              urls = []
              for raw in URL_RX.findall(desc):
                  clean = html.unescape(raw).rstrip(".,;:!?)\]}>'\"")
                  if clean and clean not in urls:
                      urls.append(clean)
              rec["links"] = urls
              return rec

          def resolve_link(url: str) -> dict:
              result = {"url": url, "final_url": url, "status": None, "error": None}
              try:
                  # Stream only a tiny prefix. This follows shorteners without downloading save files.
                  with SESSION.get(url, timeout=18, allow_redirects=True, stream=True) as r:
                      result["status"] = r.status_code
                      result["final_url"] = r.url
              except Exception as exc:
                  result["error"] = repr(exc)
              return result

          # Search in parallel so one slow query does not consume the whole run.
          search_rows: list[dict] = []
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
              futures = {pool.submit(run_flat_search, q): q for q in QUERIES}
              for fut in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
                  search_rows.extend(fut.result())

          errors = [r for r in search_rows if r.get("_error")]
          by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
          for row in search_rows:
              if row.get("_error"):
                  continue
              vid = row["id"]
              if vid not in by_id:
                  by_id[vid] = row
                  by_id[vid]["queries"] = [row["query"]]
              elif row["query"] not in by_id[vid]["queries"]:
                  by_id[vid]["queries"].append(row["query"])

          # Titles that mention the target stage go first; all unique results are still attempted.
          ordered = sorted(
              by_id.values(),
              key=lambda r: (
                  0 if TARGET_TERMS.search((r.get("title") or "")) else 1,
                  r.get("title") or "",
              ),
          )
          print(f"Flat-search rows={len(search_rows)} unique={len(ordered)}")
          print(f"Instances: invidious={len(INVIDIOUS)} piped={len(PIPED)}")

          recovered: list[dict] = []
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=14) as pool:
              futures = [pool.submit(recover_one, row) for row in ordered]
              for index, fut in enumerate(concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures), 1):
                  recovered.append(fut.result())
                  if index % 50 == 0:
                      got = sum(bool(r.get("description")) for r in recovered)
                      print(f"Recovered {index}/{len(ordered)} descriptions={got}")

          link_rows = []
          candidate_links = []
          for rec in recovered:
              for url in rec.get("links") or []:
                  row = {
                      "video_id": rec["id"],
                      "title": rec.get("title"),
                      "channel": rec.get("channel"),
                      "video_url": rec.get("video_url"),
                      "url": url,
                  }
                  link_rows.append(row)
                  low = url.lower()
                  host = urlparse(url).netloc.lower()
                  if host in SAVE_HOSTS or any(h in host for h in SAVE_HOSTS) or ".zip" in low:
                      candidate_links.append(row)

          # Resolve only likely save/link-hub URLs, with deduplication and a conservative cap.
          unique_urls = list(dict.fromkeys(row["url"] for row in candidate_links))[:500]
          resolved_map: dict[str, dict] = {}
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=12) as pool:
              for result in pool.map(resolve_link, unique_urls):
                  resolved_map[result["url"]] = result
          for row in candidate_links:
              row["resolved"] = resolved_map.get(row["url"])

          def score(rec: dict) -> int:
              title = rec.get("title") or ""
              desc = rec.get("description") or ""
              hay = (title + "\n" + desc).lower()
              points = 0
              for term, weight in [
                  ("rocket science", 12), ("cargo rocket", 10), ("launch pad", 7),
                  ("satellite", 5), ("nauvis orbit", 4), ("space exploration 0.7", 6),
                  ("save file", 18), ("save game", 18), ("download save", 20),
                  ("google drive", 18), ("dropbox", 18), ("mediafire", 18),
              ]:
                  if term in hay:
                      points += weight
              if any(row["video_id"] == rec["id"] for row in candidate_links):
                  points += 25
              # Late-space terms do not erase the candidate, but they lower its inspection priority.
              for term in ("cryonite", "vulcanite", "holmium", "iridium", "astronomic science", "energy science", "deep space"):
                  if term in hay:
                      points -= 6
              return points

          for rec in recovered:
              rec["score"] = score(rec)
          ranked = sorted(recovered, key=lambda r: (-r["score"], r.get("title") or ""))

          (OUT / "flat-search.json").write_text(json.dumps(search_rows, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "videos.json").write_text(json.dumps(recovered, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "all-links.json").write_text(json.dumps(link_rows, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "candidate-links.json").write_text(json.dumps(candidate_links, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "ranked.json").write_text(json.dumps(ranked, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "errors.json").write_text(json.dumps(errors, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

          lines = [
              f"Unique videos: {len(ordered)}",
              f"Descriptions recovered: {sum(bool(r.get('description')) for r in recovered)}",
              f"Videos with any extracted URL: {sum(bool(r.get('links')) for r in recovered)}",
              f"Likely save/link-hub URLs: {len(candidate_links)}",
              "",
              "LIKELY SAVE OR LINK-HUB URLS",
              "=" * 80,
          ]
          for row in candidate_links:
              resolved = row.get("resolved") or {}
              lines.extend([
                  f"{row.get('channel')} | {row.get('title')}",
                  row.get("video_url") or "",
                  row.get("url") or "",
                  ("=> " + str(resolved.get("final_url"))) if resolved.get("final_url") and resolved.get("final_url") != row.get("url") else "",
                  "",
              ])
          lines.extend(["", "TOP RANKED VIDEOS", "=" * 80])
          for rec in ranked[:250]:
              lines.extend([
                  f"SCORE {rec['score']} | {rec.get('channel')} | {rec.get('title')}",
                  rec.get("video_url") or "",
                  f"description source: {rec.get('description_source')}",
                  (rec.get("description") or "")[:5000],
                  "",
              ])
          (OUT / "SUMMARY.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
          print("\n".join(lines[:500]))
          PY
          python3 se-youtube-alt-work/hunt.py | tee se-youtube-alt-result/console.txt

      - name: Publish results to a dedicated branch
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B tmp-se-youtube-alt-result-20260824

name: Deep-search YouTube for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-youtube-deep-result-20260824

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and descriptions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result

========================================================================================================================
BRANCH: tmp-se-youtube-alt2-20260824
PATH: .github/workflows/tmp-se-youtube-alt.yml
SIZE: 18395 | TARGET_HITS: 44 | STAGE_HITS: 16
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: Alternate YouTube hunt for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [tmp-se-youtube-alt-20260824]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  hunt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 110
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and recover descriptions through alternate endpoints
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf se-youtube-alt-work se-youtube-alt-result
          mkdir -p se-youtube-alt-work se-youtube-alt-result
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp requests
          cat > se-youtube-alt-work/hunt.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations

          import concurrent.futures
          import html
          import json
          import pathlib
          import re
          import subprocess
          import time
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          import requests

          OUT = pathlib.Path("se-youtube-alt-result")
          OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          SESSION = requests.Session()
          SESSION.headers.update({
              "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/126 Safari/537.36",
              "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
          })

          QUERIES = [
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 first cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 Nauvis orbit",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 satellite",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 launch pad",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 2025 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 2026 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration save download",
              "Factorio SE save game download",
          ]

          URL_RX = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\"'\\]+", re.I)
          SAVE_HOSTS = (
              "drive.google.com", "docs.google.com", "dropbox.com", "mediafire.com",
              "mega.nz", "mega.io", "onedrive.live.com", "1drv.ms", "github.com",
              "gitlab.com", "factorio.com", "patreon.com", "ko-fi.com", "gumroad.com",
              "itch.io", "bit.ly", "tinyurl.com", "linktr.ee", "beacons.ai",
          )
          TARGET_TERMS = re.compile(
              r"(?i)(save\s*(?:game|file|download)|download\s*(?:the\s*)?save|"
              r"rocket\s+science|cargo\s+rocket|launch\s+pad|satellite|nauvis\s+orbit|"
              r"space\s+exploration\s+0\.7|\bse\s*0\.7)"
          )

          def run_flat_search(query: str) -> list[dict]:
              cmd = [
                  "yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-single-json", "--no-warnings",
                  f"ytsearch100:{query}",
              ]
              proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
              if proc.returncode:
                  return [{"_error": proc.stderr[-4000:], "_query": query}]
              data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
              result = []
              for entry in data.get("entries") or []:
                  if not entry or not entry.get("id"):
                      continue
                  result.append({
                      "id": entry.get("id"),
                      "title": entry.get("title"),
                      "url": entry.get("url") or f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={entry['id']}",
                      "channel": entry.get("channel") or entry.get("uploader"),
                      "channel_id": entry.get("channel_id") or entry.get("uploader_id"),
                      "timestamp": entry.get("timestamp"),
                      "duration": entry.get("duration"),
                      "playlist": entry.get("playlist"),
                      "playlist_id": entry.get("playlist_id"),
                      "query": query,
                  })
              return result

          def json_string_value(raw: str) -> str:
              try:
                  return json.loads('"' + raw + '"')
              except Exception:
                  return html.unescape(raw.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\/", "/"))

          def extract_description(text: str) -> str | None:
              patterns = [
                  r'"shortDescription"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
                  r'"description"\s*:\s*\{\s*"simpleText"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
                  r'"description"\s*:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',
              ]
              for pat in patterns:
                  match = re.search(pat, text, re.S)
                  if match:
                      value = json_string_value(match.group(1)).strip()
                      if value:
                          return value
              return None

          def get_text(url: str, timeout: int = 18) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
              try:
                  response = SESSION.get(url, timeout=timeout)
                  if response.status_code == 200 and response.text:
                      return response.text, None
                  return None, f"HTTP {response.status_code}"
              except Exception as exc:
                  return None, repr(exc)

          def load_instances() -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
              inv: list[str] = []
              piped: list[str] = []
              try:
                  data = SESSION.get("https://api.invidious.io/instances.json?sort_by=health", timeout=20).json()
                  for host, meta in data:
                      if isinstance(meta, dict) and meta.get("api") and meta.get("type") == "https":
                          inv.append("https://" + host.rstrip("/"))
              except Exception:
                  pass
              try:
                  data = SESSION.get("https://piped.video/api/v1/instances", timeout=20).json()
                  for item in data:
                      api = item.get("api_url") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
                      if api:
                          piped.append(api.rstrip("/"))
              except Exception:
                  pass
              # Frequently available historical endpoints, tried only after dynamic lists.
              inv.extend([
                  "https://yewtu.be", "https://inv.nadeko.net", "https://invidious.nerdvpn.de",
                  "https://invidious.privacyredirect.com",
              ])
              piped.extend([
                  "https://pipedapi.kavin.rocks", "https://pipedapi.adminforge.de",
                  "https://pipedapi.reallyaweso.me",
              ])
              return list(dict.fromkeys(inv))[:12], list(dict.fromkeys(piped))[:12]

          INVIDIOUS, PIPED = load_instances()

          def description_from_apis(video_id: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
              errors = []
              for base in INVIDIOUS[:6]:
                  try:
                      r = SESSION.get(f"{base}/api/v1/videos/{video_id}", timeout=12)
                      if r.status_code == 200:
                          d = r.json()
                          desc = d.get("description") or d.get("descriptionHtml")
                          if desc:
                              return html.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", desc)), f"invidious:{base}"
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{r.status_code}")
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{type(exc).__name__}")
              for base in PIPED[:6]:
                  try:
                      r = SESSION.get(f"{base}/streams/{video_id}", timeout=12)
                      if r.status_code == 200:
                          d = r.json()
                          desc = d.get("description")
                          if desc:
                              return desc, f"piped:{base}"
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{r.status_code}")
                  except Exception as exc:
                      errors.append(f"{base}:{type(exc).__name__}")
              return None, "; ".join(errors[-8:])

          def recover_one(base: dict) -> dict:
              video_id = base["id"]
              rec = dict(base)
              rec["video_url"] = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}"
              rec["description"] = None
              rec["description_source"] = None
              rec["errors"] = []

              endpoints = [
                  f"https://www.youtube.com/embed/{video_id}?hl=en",
                  f"https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/{video_id}?hl=en",
                  f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}&hl=en&gl=US&persist_hl=1",
              ]
              for endpoint in endpoints:
                  text, err = get_text(endpoint)
                  if text:
                      desc = extract_description(text)
                      if desc:
                          rec["description"] = desc
                          rec["description_source"] = endpoint.split('/')[2]
                          break
                  if err:
                      rec["errors"].append(endpoint.split('/')[2] + ":" + err)

              if not rec["description"]:
                  desc, source = description_from_apis(video_id)
                  if desc:
                      rec["description"] = desc
                      rec["description_source"] = source
                  elif source:
                      rec["errors"].append(source)

              if not rec["description"]:
                  text, err = get_text(f"https://r.jina.ai/http://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}", timeout=30)
                  if text and len(text) > 80:
                      rec["jina_text"] = text[:30000]
                      # Jina often labels the description, but even when it does not, preserving the
                      # page text lets the link extractor recover description URLs.
                      rec["description"] = text
                      rec["description_source"] = "r.jina.ai"
                  elif err:
                      rec["errors"].append("jina:" + err)

              desc = rec.get("description") or ""
              urls = []
              for raw in URL_RX.findall(desc):
                  clean = html.unescape(raw).rstrip(".,;:!?)\]}>'\"")
                  if clean and clean not in urls:
                      urls.append(clean)
              rec["links"] = urls
              return rec

          def resolve_link(url: str) -> dict:
              result = {"url": url, "final_url": url, "status": None, "error": None}
              try:
                  # Stream only a tiny prefix. This follows shorteners without downloading save files.
                  with SESSION.get(url, timeout=18, allow_redirects=True, stream=True) as r:
                      result["status"] = r.status_code
                      result["final_url"] = r.url
              except Exception as exc:
                  result["error"] = repr(exc)
              return result

          # Search in parallel so one slow query does not consume the whole run.
          search_rows: list[dict] = []
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
              futures = {pool.submit(run_flat_search, q): q for q in QUERIES}
              for fut in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
                  search_rows.extend(fut.result())

          errors = [r for r in search_rows if r.get("_error")]
          by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
          for row in search_rows:
              if row.get("_error"):
                  continue
              vid = row["id"]
              if vid not in by_id:
                  by_id[vid] = row
                  by_id[vid]["queries"] = [row["query"]]
              elif row["query"] not in by_id[vid]["queries"]:
                  by_id[vid]["queries"].append(row["query"])

          # Titles that mention the target stage go first; all unique results are still attempted.
          ordered = sorted(
              by_id.values(),
              key=lambda r: (
                  0 if TARGET_TERMS.search((r.get("title") or "")) else 1,
                  r.get("title") or "",
              ),
          )
          print(f"Flat-search rows={len(search_rows)} unique={len(ordered)}")
          print(f"Instances: invidious={len(INVIDIOUS)} piped={len(PIPED)}")

          recovered: list[dict] = []
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=14) as pool:
              futures = [pool.submit(recover_one, row) for row in ordered]
              for index, fut in enumerate(concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures), 1):
                  recovered.append(fut.result())
                  if index % 50 == 0:
                      got = sum(bool(r.get("description")) for r in recovered)
                      print(f"Recovered {index}/{len(ordered)} descriptions={got}")

          link_rows = []
          candidate_links = []
          for rec in recovered:
              for url in rec.get("links") or []:
                  row = {
                      "video_id": rec["id"],
                      "title": rec.get("title"),
                      "channel": rec.get("channel"),
                      "video_url": rec.get("video_url"),
                      "url": url,
                  }
                  link_rows.append(row)
                  low = url.lower()
                  host = urlparse(url).netloc.lower()
                  if host in SAVE_HOSTS or any(h in host for h in SAVE_HOSTS) or ".zip" in low:
                      candidate_links.append(row)

          # Resolve only likely save/link-hub URLs, with deduplication and a conservative cap.
          unique_urls = list(dict.fromkeys(row["url"] for row in candidate_links))[:500]
          resolved_map: dict[str, dict] = {}
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=12) as pool:
              for result in pool.map(resolve_link, unique_urls):
                  resolved_map[result["url"]] = result
          for row in candidate_links:
              row["resolved"] = resolved_map.get(row["url"])

          def score(rec: dict) -> int:
              title = rec.get("title") or ""
              desc = rec.get("description") or ""
              hay = (title + "\n" + desc).lower()
              points = 0
              for term, weight in [
                  ("rocket science", 12), ("cargo rocket", 10), ("launch pad", 7),
                  ("satellite", 5), ("nauvis orbit", 4), ("space exploration 0.7", 6),
                  ("save file", 18), ("save game", 18), ("download save", 20),
                  ("google drive", 18), ("dropbox", 18), ("mediafire", 18),
              ]:
                  if term in hay:
                      points += weight
              if any(row["video_id"] == rec["id"] for row in candidate_links):
                  points += 25
              # Late-space terms do not erase the candidate, but they lower its inspection priority.
              for term in ("cryonite", "vulcanite", "holmium", "iridium", "astronomic science", "energy science", "deep space"):
                  if term in hay:
                      points -= 6
              return points

          for rec in recovered:
              rec["score"] = score(rec)
          ranked = sorted(recovered, key=lambda r: (-r["score"], r.get("title") or ""))

          (OUT / "flat-search.json").write_text(json.dumps(search_rows, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "videos.json").write_text(json.dumps(recovered, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "all-links.json").write_text(json.dumps(link_rows, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "candidate-links.json").write_text(json.dumps(candidate_links, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "ranked.json").write_text(json.dumps(ranked, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          (OUT / "errors.json").write_text(json.dumps(errors, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

          lines = [
              f"Unique videos: {len(ordered)}",
              f"Descriptions recovered: {sum(bool(r.get('description')) for r in recovered)}",
              f"Videos with any extracted URL: {sum(bool(r.get('links')) for r in recovered)}",
              f"Likely save/link-hub URLs: {len(candidate_links)}",
              "",
              "LIKELY SAVE OR LINK-HUB URLS",
              "=" * 80,
          ]
          for row in candidate_links:
              resolved = row.get("resolved") or {}
              lines.extend([
                  f"{row.get('channel')} | {row.get('title')}",
                  row.get("video_url") or "",
                  row.get("url") or "",
                  ("=> " + str(resolved.get("final_url"))) if resolved.get("final_url") and resolved.get("final_url") != row.get("url") else "",
                  "",
              ])
          lines.extend(["", "TOP RANKED VIDEOS", "=" * 80])
          for rec in ranked[:250]:
              lines.extend([
                  f"SCORE {rec['score']} | {rec.get('channel')} | {rec.get('title')}",
                  rec.get("video_url") or "",
                  f"description source: {rec.get('description_source')}",
                  (rec.get("description") or "")[:5000],
                  "",
              ])
          (OUT / "SUMMARY.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
          print("\n".join(lines[:500]))
          PY
          python3 se-youtube-alt-work/hunt.py | tee se-youtube-alt-result/console.txt

      - name: Publish results to a dedicated branch
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B tmp-se-youtube-alt-result-20260824
          rm -rf tmp-se-youtube-alt
          mkdir -p tmp-se-youtube-alt
          cp -a se-youtube-alt-result/. tmp-se-youtube-alt/ || true
          git add -f tmp-se-youtube-alt
          git commit -m 'Publish alternate YouTube SE 0.7 hunt results' || true
          git push --force origin HEAD:refs/heads/tmp-se-youtube-alt-result-20260824

          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-youtube-deep
          mkdir -p tmp-se-youtube-deep
          cp -a published/. tmp-se-youtube-deep/
          git add -f tmp-se-youtube-deep
          git commit -m 'Deep-search YouTube for public SE 0.7 saves'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"
