BRANCH: tmp-se-yt-dlp-20260824
PATH: .github/workflows/tmp-se-youtube-deep-search.yml
SIZE: 5938 | TARGET_HITS: 23 | STAGE_HITS: 5
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: Deep-search YouTube for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-youtube-deep-result-20260824

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and descriptions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git checkout -B "$RESULT_BRANCH"
          rm -rf tmp-se-youtube-deep
          mkdir -p tmp-se-youtube-deep
          cp -a published/. tmp-se-youtube-deep/
          git add -f tmp-se-youtube-deep
          git commit -m 'Deep-search YouTube for public SE 0.7 saves'
          git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH"

BRANCH: tmp-se-yt-dlp-20260824
PATH: .github/workflows/tmp-se-yt-dlp.yml
SIZE: 8153 | TARGET_HITS: 26 | STAGE_HITS: 7
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: Search YouTube for public SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - tmp-se-yt-dlp-20260824

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-yt-dlp-result-20260824

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and inspect descriptions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf published
          mkdir -p published
          python3 -m pip install --upgrade yt-dlp

          cat > /tmp/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations

          import concurrent.futures
          import json
          import re
          import subprocess
          import time
          from pathlib import Path

          queries = [
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7",
              "Factorio SE 0.7",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 first space",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 first cargo rocket",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 Nauvis Orbit",
              "Factorio K2SE 0.7",
          ]

          videos: dict[str, dict] = {}
          search_errors = []

          for query in queries:
              command = [
                  "yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-single-json", "--no-warnings",
                  "--playlist-end", "120", f"ytsearch120:{query}",
              ]
              try:
                  completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
                  if completed.returncode != 0:
                      search_errors.append({"query": query, "error": completed.stderr[-4000:]})
                      continue
                  payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
                  for entry in payload.get("entries") or []:
                      if not entry or not entry.get("id"):
                          continue
                      video_id = entry["id"]
                      videos.setdefault(video_id, {
                          "id": video_id,
                          "title": entry.get("title"),
                          "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}",
                          "search_queries": [],
                      })["search_queries"].append(query)
              except Exception as exc:
                  search_errors.append({"query": query, "error": repr(exc)})

          url_re = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>'\"\])}]+", re.I)
          interesting_host_re = re.compile(
              r"(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|"
              r"github\.com|githubusercontent\.com|onedrive\.live\.com|1drv\.ms|file\.io|gofile\.io|"
              r"refactorio\.de|factorio\.com|patreon\.com|\.zip(?:$|[?&#]))",
              re.I,
          )
          save_word_re = re.compile(
              r"\b(?:save|savegame|save game|map download|world download|download|mods? sync|zip)\b",
              re.I,
          )
          stage_word_re = re.compile(
              r"(?:rocket science|cargo rocket|first space|nauvis orbit|space exploration\s*0\.7|\bSE\s*0\.7\b)",
              re.I,
          )

          def inspect(video: dict) -> dict:
              command = [
                  "yt-dlp", "--skip-download", "--dump-single-json", "--no-warnings",
                  "--socket-timeout", "45", "--retries", "2",
                  video["url"],
              ]
              try:
                  completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=240)
                  if completed.returncode != 0:
                      return {**video, "inspection_error": completed.stderr[-2500:]}
                  data = json.loads(completed.stdout)
                  description = data.get("description") or ""
                  urls = url_re.findall(description)
                  interesting_urls = [url.rstrip(".,;:") for url in urls if interesting_host_re.search(url)]
                  return {
                      **video,
                      "title": data.get("title") or video.get("title"),
                      "channel": data.get("channel") or data.get("uploader"),
                      "channel_id": data.get("channel_id") or data.get("uploader_id"),
                      "upload_date": data.get("upload_date"),
                      "duration": data.get("duration"),
                      "description": description,
                      "all_urls": urls,
                      "interesting_urls": interesting_urls,
                      "has_save_words": bool(save_word_re.search(description)),
                      "has_stage_words": bool(stage_word_re.search((data.get("title") or "") + "\n" + description)),
                  }
              except Exception as exc:
                  return {**video, "inspection_error": repr(exc)}

          video_list = list(videos.values())
          results = []
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:
              future_map = {executor.submit(inspect, video): video for video in video_list}
              for index, future in enumerate(concurrent.futures.as_completed(future_map), 1):
                  results.append(future.result())
                  if index % 25 == 0:
                      print(f"inspected {index}/{len(video_list)}", flush=True)
                      time.sleep(1)

          results.sort(key=lambda row: (row.get("upload_date") or "", row.get("title") or ""), reverse=True)
          Path("published/all-videos.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          Path("published/search-errors.json").write_text(json.dumps(search_errors, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

          leads = [
              row for row in results
              if row.get("interesting_urls") or (row.get("has_save_words") and row.get("has_stage_words"))
          ]
          Path("published/leads.json").write_text(json.dumps(leads, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

          lines = [
              f"queries={len(queries)}",
              f"unique_videos={len(video_list)}",
              f"inspected_successfully={sum('inspection_error' not in row for row in results)}",
              f"inspection_errors={sum('inspection_error' in row for row in results)}",
              f"leads={len(leads)}",
              "",
          ]
          for row in leads:
              lines.append(f"TITLE: {row.get('title')}")
              lines.append(f"DATE: {row.get('upload_date')}")
              lines.append(f"CHANNEL: {row.get('channel')}")
              lines.append(f"VIDEO: {row.get('url')}")
              lines.append("URLS:")
              for url in row.get("interesting_urls") or []:
                  lines.append(f"  {url}")
              description = row.get("description") or ""
              matched_lines = [line for line in description.splitlines() if save_word_re.search(line) or interesting_host_re.search(line)]
              if matched_lines:
                  lines.append("DESCRIPTION LINES:")
                  lines.extend(f"  {line}" for line in matched_lines[:30])
              lines.append("")
          Path("published/SUMMARY.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")

name: Deep-search YouTube for SE 0.7 saves

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-youtube-deep-result-20260824

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and descriptions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf work published
          mkdir -p work published
          python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade yt-dlp
          cat > work/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations
          import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
          P=pathlib.Path
          queries=[
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7',
            'Factorio SE 0.7',
            'Factorio Space Exploration rocket science',
            'Factorio Space Exploration cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration first cargo rocket',
            'Factorio Space Exploration pre space base',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2025',
            'Factorio Space Exploration 2026',
            'Factorio K2SE 0.7',
          ]
          records={}
          errors=[]
          for q in queries:
            cmd=['yt-dlp','--flat-playlist','--dump-single-json',f'ytsearch100:{q}']
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','stderr':p.stderr[-5000:]});continue
              data=json.loads(p.stdout)
              for e in data.get('entries') or []:
                if not e:continue
                vid=e.get('id');url=e.get('url') or (f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}' if vid else None)
                if vid and url: records.setdefault(vid,{'id':vid,'url':url,'search_queries':[]})['search_queries'].append(q)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'query':q,'stage':'search','error':repr(exc)})
          print('unique videos',len(records))
          details=[]
          for i,(vid,base) in enumerate(records.items(),1):
            try:
              p=subprocess.run(['yt-dlp','--skip-download','--dump-single-json','--no-warnings',base['url']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
              if p.returncode:
                errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','stderr':p.stderr[-3000:]});continue
              d=json.loads(p.stdout)
              rec={k:d.get(k) for k in ('id','title','description','channel','channel_id','uploader','uploader_id','upload_date','timestamp','duration','webpage_url','original_url','playlist','playlist_id')}
              rec['search_queries']=base['search_queries']
              details.append(rec)
            except Exception as exc:errors.append({'id':vid,'stage':'metadata','error':repr(exc)})
            if i%50==0:print('metadata',i,'/',len(records))
          url_rx=re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"\']+')
          save_terms=re.compile(r'(?i)(save ?game|save ?file|save ?download|download save|google drive|dropbox|mediafire|mega\.|onedrive|github|patreon|rocket science|cargo rocket|space exploration 0\.7|\bse 0\.7)')
          link_records=[];interesting=[]
          for r in details:
            desc=r.get('description') or ''
            links=[]
            for u in url_rx.findall(desc):
              u=u.rstrip(').,;]}')
              links.append(u)
              low=u.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ('drive.google.com','docs.google.com','dropbox.com','mediafire.com','mega.nz','mega.io','onedrive.live.com','1drv.ms','github.com','gitlab.com','.zip','factorio.com','patreon.com','ko-fi.com')):
                link_records.append({'video_id':r['id'],'title':r.get('title'),'upload_date':r.get('upload_date'),'channel':r.get('channel'),'url':u,'video_url':r.get('webpage_url')})
            r['links']=links
            hay=(r.get('title') or '')+'\n'+desc
            if save_terms.search(hay):interesting.append(r)
          P('published/videos.json').write_text(json.dumps(details,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/interesting.json').write_text(json.dumps(interesting,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/external-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(link_records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          P('published/errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
          lines=[f'Unique search results: {len(records)}',f'Metadata fetched: {len(details)}',f'Interesting descriptions: {len(interesting)}',f'Candidate external links: {len(link_records)}','']
          for x in link_records:
            lines += [f"{x['upload_date']} | {x['channel']} | {x['title']}",x['video_url'] or '',x['url'],'']
          lines += ['\nINTERESTING VIDEO DESCRIPTIONS\n']
          for r in interesting[:500]:
            lines += ['='*80,f"{r.get('upload_date')} | {r.get('channel')} | {r.get('title')}",r.get('webpage_url') or '',(r.get('description') or '')[:12000]]
          P('published/SUMMARY.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
          print('\n'.join(lines[:1200]))
          PY
          python3 work/search.py | tee published/console.txt

      - name: Publish search result

name: Search YouTube for public SE 0.7 saves

on:

    branches:
      - tmp-se-yt-dlp-20260824

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  RESULT_BRANCH: tmp-se-yt-dlp-result-20260824

jobs:
  search:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search videos and inspect descriptions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf published
          mkdir -p published
          python3 -m pip install --upgrade yt-dlp

          cat > /tmp/search.py <<'PY'
          from __future__ import annotations

          import concurrent.futures
          import json
          import re
          import subprocess
          import time
          from pathlib import Path

          queries = [
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7",
              "Factorio SE 0.7",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 cargo rocket",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 rocket science",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 playthrough",
              "Factorio Space Exploration 0.7 lets play",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 first space",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 first cargo rocket",
              "Factorio SE 0.7 Nauvis Orbit",
              "Factorio K2SE 0.7",
          ]

          videos: dict[str, dict] = {}
          search_errors = []

          for query in queries:
              command = [
                  "yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "--dump-single-json", "--no-warnings",
                  "--playlist-end", "120", f"ytsearch120:{query}",
              ]
              try:
                  completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
                  if completed.returncode != 0:
                      search_errors.append({"query": query, "error": completed.stderr[-4000:]})
                      continue
                  payload = json.loads(completed.stdout)
                  for entry in payload.get("entries") or []:
                      if not entry or not entry.get("id"):
                          continue
                      video_id = entry["id"]
                      videos.setdefault(video_id, {
                          "id": video_id,
                          "title": entry.get("title"),
                          "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}",
                          "search_queries": [],
                      })["search_queries"].append(query)
              except Exception as exc:
                  search_errors.append({"query": query, "error": repr(exc)})

          url_re = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>'\"\])}]+", re.I)
          interesting_host_re = re.compile(
              r"(?:drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|dropbox\.com|mega\.nz|mediafire\.com|"
              r"github\.com|githubusercontent\.com|onedrive\.live\.com|1drv\.ms|file\.io|gofile\.io|"
              r"refactorio\.de|factorio\.com|patreon\.com|\.zip(?:$|[?&#]))",
              re.I,
          )
          save_word_re = re.compile(
              r"\b(?:save|savegame|save game|map download|world download|download|mods? sync|zip)\b",
              re.I,
          )
          stage_word_re = re.compile(
              r"(?:rocket science|cargo rocket|first space|nauvis orbit|space exploration\s*0\.7|\bSE\s*0\.7\b)",
              re.I,
          )

          def inspect(video: dict) -> dict:
              command = [
                  "yt-dlp", "--skip-download", "--dump-single-json", "--no-warnings",
                  "--socket-timeout", "45", "--retries", "2",
                  video["url"],
              ]
              try:
                  completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=240)
                  if completed.returncode != 0:
                      return {**video, "inspection_error": completed.stderr[-2500:]}
                  data = json.loads(completed.stdout)
                  description = data.get("description") or ""
                  urls = url_re.findall(description)
                  interesting_urls = [url.rstrip(".,;:") for url in urls if interesting_host_re.search(url)]
                  return {
                      **video,
                      "title": data.get("title") or video.get("title"),
                      "channel": data.get("channel") or data.get("uploader"),
                      "channel_id": data.get("channel_id") or data.get("uploader_id"),
                      "upload_date": data.get("upload_date"),
                      "duration": data.get("duration"),
                      "description": description,
                      "all_urls": urls,
                      "interesting_urls": interesting_urls,
                      "has_save_words": bool(save_word_re.search(description)),
                      "has_stage_words": bool(stage_word_re.search((data.get("title") or "") + "\n" + description)),
                  }
              except Exception as exc:
                  return {**video, "inspection_error": repr(exc)}

          video_list = list(videos.values())
          results = []
          with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:
              future_map = {executor.submit(inspect, video): video for video in video_list}
              for index, future in enumerate(concurrent.futures.as_completed(future_map), 1):
                  results.append(future.result())
                  if index % 25 == 0:
                      print(f"inspected {index}/{len(video_list)}", flush=True)
                      time.sleep(1)

          results.sort(key=lambda row: (row.get("upload_date") or "", row.get("title") or ""), reverse=True)
          Path("published/all-videos.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
          Path("published/search-errors.json").write_text(json.dumps(search_errors, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

          leads = [
              row for row in results
              if row.get("interesting_urls") or (row.get("has_save_words") and row.get("has_stage_words"))
          ]
          Path("published/leads.json").write_text(json.dumps(leads, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

          lines = [
              f"queries={len(queries)}",
              f"unique_videos={len(video_list)}",
              f"inspected_successfully={sum('inspection_error' not in row for row in results)}",
              f"inspection_errors={sum('inspection_error' in row for row in results)}",
              f"leads={len(leads)}",
              "",
          ]
          for row in leads:
              lines.append(f"TITLE: {row.get('title')}")
              lines.append(f"DATE: {row.get('upload_date')}")
              lines.append(f"CHANNEL: {row.get('channel')}")
              lines.append(f"VIDEO: {row.get('url')}")
              lines.append("URLS:")
              for url in row.get("interesting_urls") or []:
                  lines.append(f"  {url}")
              description = row.get("description") or ""
              matched_lines = [line for line in description.splitlines() if save_word_re.search(line) or interesting_host_re.search(line)]
              if matched_lines:
                  lines.append("DESCRIPTION LINES:")
                  lines.extend(f"  {line}" for line in matched_lines[:30])
              lines.append("")
          Path("published/SUMMARY.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
          print("\n".join(lines[:20]))
